When Zhāng Miǎo rebelled, [Zhāng] Miǎo captured [Bì] Chén’s mother and younger brother,  wives and children. The Excellency apologized and sent him away, saying: “Your elderly mother is with them. You can go.” [Bì] Chén bowed his head [to the ground] with no second thoughts.  The Excellency commended him and shed tears for him. But when he went out, he then deserted and submitted [to Zhāng Miǎo]. When [Lǚ] Bù was defeated, [Bì] Chén was captured alive. Everyone was afraid for [Bì] Chén. The Excellency said: “Someone who is filial to their parents, how can they not also be loyal to their lord? It is what I seek.” Appointed him as Lǔ Chancellor. <a href="#annotation-42" id="source-42">[42]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
初，公為兗州，以東平畢諶為別駕。張邈之叛也，邈劫諶母弟妻子；公謝遣之，曰：「卿老母在彼，可去。」諶頓首無二心，公嘉之，為之流涕。既出，遂亡歸。及布破，諶生得，眾為諶懼，公曰：「夫人孝於其親者，豈不亦忠於君乎！吾所求也。」以為魯相。〔一〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-42" id="annotation-42">[42]</a> Wèi shū states: Yuán Shào previously with former Grand Commandant Yáng Biāo, Chief Prolonging Autumn Liáng Shào, and Minister Treasurer Kǒng Róng had conflict,  and wished to have the Excellency take advantage of some other fault to execute them. The Excellency said: “Right now Heaven’s Under has collapsed apart, powerful figures all rising up, supporting ministers and ruling lords harbor discontent, each having hearts to act for themselves. This is the time of superiors and subordinates suspecting one another. Even if they are treated without suspicion, yet they are afraid and do not trust. If there is a purge, then who would not be fearful for themselves? Moreover, for a commoner rising in plain clothes amid dust and dirt, to be oppressed and entrapped by mediocre men, could one contain the resentment? Gāozǔ pardoned his enmity of Yōng Chǐ and everyone’s feelings were calmed by this.  How can one forget this?” [Yuán] Shào believed that the Excellency was outside using claims of public righteousness to inside in fact break away from him, and harbored deep resentment.

Your Servant Sōngzhī  believes: Yáng Biāo also once was persecuted by Wèi Wǔ, almost to the point of death, and Kǒng Róng indeed did not escape from execution and extermination.  How is this what is called “first enacting his words and afterward following them?”  It is not the knowing that is difficult, it is the enacting of it. That can be believed.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏書曰：袁紹宿與故太尉楊彪、大長秋梁紹、少府孔融有隙，欲使公以他過誅之。公曰：「當今天下土崩瓦解，雄豪並起，輔相君長，人懷怏怏，各有自為之心，此上下相疑之秋也，雖以無嫌待之，猶懼未信；如有所除，則誰不自危？且夫起布衣，在塵垢之間，為庸人之所陵陷，可勝怨乎！高祖赦雍齒之讎而群情以安，如何忘之？」紹以為公外託公義，內實離異，深懷怨望。臣松之以為楊彪亦曾為魏武所困，幾至于死，孔融竟不免于誅滅，豈所謂先行其言而後從之哉！非知之難，其在行之，信矣。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Fourth Year, Spring, Second Moon [199 Mar 15 – Apr 13], the Excellency returned and reached Chāngyì.  Zhāng Yáng’s officer Yáng Chǒu killed [Zhāng] Yáng, Suī Gù also killed [Yáng] Chǒu, led the multitudes to join Yuán Shào, garrisoned Shèquǎn.  
Summer, Fourth Moon [199 May 13 – Jun 11], advanced the army to overlook the Hé, sent Shǐ Huàn and Cáo Rén  to cross the Hé and strike them. [Suī] Gù sent [Zhāng] Yáng’s former Chief Scribe Xuē Hóng and Hénèi Administrator Miào Shàng  to remain to defend and personally commanded troops north to invite [Yuán] Shào to come rescue, with [Shǐ] Huàn and [Cáo] Rén encountered each other at Quǎnchéng.  Engaged in battle, greatly defeated them, beheaded [Suī] Gù. The Excellency therefore crossed the Hé and besieged Shèquǎn. [Xuē] Hóng and [Miào] Shàng led the multitudes to surrender, enfeoffed as Ranked Marquesses. Returned the army to Áo Granary. Appointed Wèi Zhǒng  as Hénèi Administrator, entrusted with affairs north of the Hé.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
四年春二月，公還至昌邑。張楊將楊醜殺楊，眭固又殺醜，以其眾屬袁紹，屯射犬。夏四月，進軍臨河，使史渙、曹仁渡河擊之。固使楊故長史薛洪、河內太守繆尚留守，自將兵北迎紹求救，與渙、仁相遇犬城。交戰，大破之，斬固。公遂濟河，圍射犬。洪、尚率眾降，封為列侯，還軍敖倉。以魏种為河內太守，屬以河北事。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Previously, the Excellency had nominated [Wèi] Zhǒng as Filial-Incorruptible. When Yǎn Province rebelled, the Excellency said: “Only Wèi Zhǒng would never abandon me.” When he heard [Wèi] Zhǒng had fled, the Excellency angrily said: “[Wèi] Zhǒng if you do not flee south to the Yuè or north to the Hú  I will never let you go!” When subduing Shèquǎn, captured [Wèi] Zhǒng alive. The Excellency said: “It is only his talent!” and released his bonds and employed him.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
初，公舉种孝廉。兗州叛，公曰：「唯魏种且不棄孤也。」及聞种走，公怒曰：「种不南走越、北走胡，不置汝也！」既下射犬，生禽种，公曰：「唯其才也！」釋其縛而用之。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
At the time Yuán Shào had already conquered Gōngsūn Zàn and united the lands of four provinces,  his multitudes over a hundred thousand, and was about to advance his army to attack Xǔ. The various officers believed he could not be matched. The Excellency said: “I know what sort of man [Yuán] Shào is. His ambition is large but wisdom is small, appearance strict but guts weak, jealously fierce but little authority, troops many but deployments confused, officers arrogant and governance not united. Though his lands are broad, and though his provisions are abundance, that is just to be presented over to me.”
Autumn, Eighth Moon [199 Sep 8 – Oct 7], the Excellency advanced the army to Líyáng, sent Zāng Bà and others to enter Qīng Province to ravage Qí, Běihǎi, and Dōng’ān, and left Yú Jīn to garrison the Hé’s upper bank. 
Ninth Moon [199 Oct 8 – Nov 5], the Excellency returned to Xǔ and divided troops to defend Guāndù. 
Winter, Eleventh Moon [199 Dec 6 – 200 Jan 3], Zhāng Xiù led his multitudes to surrender, enfeoffed as a Ranked Marquess.
Twelfth Moon [200 Jan 4 – Feb 2], the Excellency stationed Guāndù.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
是時袁紹既并公孫瓚，兼四州之地，眾十餘萬，將進軍攻許，諸將以為不可敵，公曰：「吾知紹之為人，志大而智小，色厲而膽薄，忌克而少威，兵多而分畫不明，將驕而政令不一，土地雖廣，糧食雖豐，適足以為吾奉也。」秋八月，公進軍黎陽，使臧霸等入青州破齊、北海、東安，留于禁屯河上。九月，公還許，分兵守官渡。冬十一月，張繡率眾降，封列侯。十二月，公軍官渡。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Yuán Shù from since his defeat at Chén gradually became destitute. Yuán Tán  from Qīng Province was sent to invite him. [Yuán] Shù wished to pass by Xiàpī’s north. The Excellency sent Liú Bèi and Zhū Líng  to intercept him. It happened that [Yuán] Shù died of illness. Chéng Yù and Guō Jiā heard that the Excellency had sent [Liú] Bèi, and said to the Excellency: “Liú Bèi cannot be released.” The Excellency was regretful, pursued him but was too late. Before [Liú] Bèi had gone east, he had secretly with Dǒng Chéng and others plotted rebellion.  When he reached Xiàpī, he therefore killed Xú Province Inspector Chē Zhòu  and mobilized troops to garrison Pèi. Sent Liú Dài and Wáng Zhōng  to strike him, [they] could not overcome him. <a href="#annotation-43" id="source-43">[43]</a> 
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
袁術自敗於陳，稍困，袁譚自青州遣迎之。術欲從下邳北過，公遣劉備、朱靈要之。會術病死。程昱、郭嘉聞公遣備，言於公曰：「劉備不可縱。」公悔，追之不及。備之未東也，陰與董承等謀反，至下邳，遂殺徐州刺史車冑，舉兵屯沛。遣劉岱、王忠擊之，不克〔一〕。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-43" id="annotation-43">[43]</a> Xiàn-dì Chūnqiū states: [Liú] Bèi said to [Liú] Dài and the rest: “Even if a hundred of you came, how would it match me? If Excellency Cáo  personally came, only then would things be uncertain!”

Wèi Wǔ Gùshì  states: [Liú] Dài appellation Gōngshān was a Pèi state man. As Excellency of Works’s Chief Scribe he followed on campaign and had achievements, enfeoffed a Ranked Marquess.

Wèi lüè  states: Wáng Zhōng was a Fúfēng man.  When young he became a precinct chief. When the Three Adjuncts were in chaos, [Wáng] Zhōng due to starvation ate human flesh, and followed those of his group south toward Wǔ Pass. It happened that Lóu Zǐbó  was sent by Jīng Province to welcome refugees from the north. [Wáng] Zhōng did not wish to go, and therefore led the others to oppose and strike him, seizing his troops, gathering multitudes of over a thousand men to submit to the Excellency. Appointed [Wáng] Zhōng as a Central Cadet General,  accompanying on suppression campaigns. The Five Office General [Cáo Pī]  knew that [Wáng] Zhōng had once eaten human flesh, and therefore when he followed the chariot in going out, ordered performers to obtain skulls and bones from tombs and tie them to [Wáng] Zhōng’s horse’s saddle to make fun and laugh.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　獻帝春秋曰：備謂岱等曰：「使汝百人來，其無如我何；曹公自來，未可知耳！」魏武故事曰：岱字公山，沛國人。以司空長史從征伐有功，封列侯。魏略曰：王忠，扶風人，少為亭長。三輔亂，忠飢乏噉人，隨輩南向武關。值婁子伯為荊州遣迎北方客人；忠不欲去，因率等仵逆擊之，奪其兵，聚眾千餘人以歸公。拜忠中郎將，從征討。五官將知忠嘗噉人，因從駕出行，令俳取冢間髑髏繫著忠馬鞍，以為歡笑。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Lújiāng Administrator Liú Xūn led his multitudes to surrender,  enfeoffed as a Ranked Marquess.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
廬江太守劉勳率眾降，封為列侯。
:::
:::

## Jiàn'ān 5 - 12 (200 - 207) {.unnumbered}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Fifth Year, Spring, Standard Moon [200 Feb 3 – Mar 2], Dǒng Chéng and the rest’s plot leaked, all were submitted to execution.  The Excellency was about to personally campaign east against [Liú] Bèi. The various officers all said: “The one competing with Your Excellency for Heaven’s Under is Yuán Shào. Now [Yuán] Shào is about to come but you ignore him to go east. [If Yuán] Shào takes advantage to our rear, what then?” The Excellency said: “Liú Bèi is a hero among men. Now if we do not strike, he will certainly become a later danger. <a href="#annotation-44" id="source-44">[44]</a> Though Yuán Shào has large ambitions, yet in perceiving situations he is slow, and certainly will not move.” Guō Jiā also encouraged the Excellency, therefore he went east and struck [Liú] Bèi, defeated him, captured alive his officer Xiàhóu Bó.  [Liú] Bèi fled to [Yuán] Shào. Captured his wives and children. [Liú] Bèi’s officer Guān Yǔ  garrisoned Xiàpī. Again advanced and attacked him. [Guān] Yǔ surrendered. Chāng Xī rebelled in support of [Liú] Bèi, also attacked and defeated him. The Excellency returned to Guāndù. [Yuán] Shào in the end did not set out.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
五年春正月，董承等謀泄，皆伏誅。公將自東征備，諸將皆曰：「與公爭天下者，袁紹也。今紹方來而棄之東，紹乘人後，若何？」公曰：「夫劉備，人傑也，今不擊，必為後患。〔一〕袁紹雖有大志，而見事遲，必不動也。」郭嘉亦勸公，遂東擊備，破之，生禽其將夏侯博。備走奔紹，獲其妻子。備將關羽屯下邳，復進攻之，羽降。昌豨叛為備，又攻破之。公還官渡，紹卒不出。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-44" id="annotation-44">[44]</a> Sūn Shèng’s Wèishì Chūnqiū  says: He answered the various officers saying: “Liú Bèi is a hero among men, and will create grief for me.”

Your Servant Sōngzhī believes: Historians in recording speech often made embellishments, therefore what is narrated in the earlier records have things that are not true, and later compilers also recklessly revised them, so the deviation from the truth, is it not all the more distant? Generally Sūn Shèng in compiling his books often used the Zuǒ-shì  to change the older text, and this was not the only instance. Alas! What can later scholars trust? Moreover Wèi Wǔ was about to have Heaven’s Under as his driving ambition, and so using Fūchāi’s speech of facing death was incredibly wrong in its categorization. 
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　孫盛魏氏春秋云：答諸將曰：「劉備，人傑也，將生憂寡人。」

臣松之以為史之記言，既多潤色，故前載所述有非實者矣，後之作者又生意改之，于失實也，不亦彌遠乎！凡孫盛製書，多用左氏以易舊文，如此者非一。嗟乎，後之學者將何取信哉？且魏武方以天下勵志，而用夫差分死之言，尤非其類。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Second Moon [200 Mar 3 – Apr 1], [Yuán] Shào sent Guō Tú, Chúnyú Qióng, and Yán Liáng to attack Dōng Prefecture Administrator Liú Yán at Báimǎ.  [Yuán] Shào led troops to reach Líyáng, about to cross the Hé.
Summer, Fourth Moon [200 May 2 – May 30], the Excellency went north to rescue [Liú] Yán. Xún Yōu advised the Excellency saying: “Now the troops are few and cannot match them, so dividing their momentum is thus appropriate. If Your Excellency arrives at Yánjīn,  as if about to ferry troops across toward their rear, [Yuán] Shào will certainly go west in answer to this. Afterward use light troops to attack Báimǎ, surprising where they are unprepared, and Yán Liáng can be taken.” The Excellency followed this. [Yuán] Shào heard that troops were crossing, and at once divided troops to go west in answer to it. The Excellency then led the army on double march to Báimǎ, had not yet reached by over ten lǐ, when [Yán] Liáng was greatly alarmed, and came to oppose in battle. Sent Zhāng Liáo and Guān Yǔ at the front, struck and defeated and beheaded [Yán] Liáng.  Therefore relieved Báimǎ’s siege, evacuated its civilians, and along the Hé went west. [Yuán] Shào thereupon crossed the Hé and pursued the Excellency’s army, reaching Yánjīn’s south. The Excellency reined in the troops to halt and camp below Nánbǎn,  sending someone to climb up the ramparts to watch them, who said: “It could be five to six hundred cavalry.” Soon afterward again reported: “Cavalry is gradually increasing, infantry is uncountable.” The Excellency said: “Do not report again.” Thus he ordered the cavalry to unfasten the saddles and release the horses. At the time, Báimǎ’s supply wagons were on the road. The various officers believed that the enemy cavalry was many, and it was better to return to protect the camp. Xún Yōu said: “This is the way to trap the enemy, how can we leave them?” [Yuán] Shào’s cavalry officer Wén Chǒu  with Liú Bèi commanding five to six thousand cavalry beginning to end arrived. The various officers again reported: “We should mount horses.” The Excellency said: “Not yet.” Shortly afterward, the cavalry arriving gradually increased, and some divided to capture the supply wagons. The Excellency said: “[Now we] can.” Thus they all mounted horses. At the time the cavalry was not even six hundred. Then unleashed the troops to strike, greatly defeating them, beheading [Wén] Chǒu. [Yán] Liáng and [Wén] Chǒu were both [Yuán] Shào’s famed officers. In two battles both were taken, and [Yuán] Shào’s army was greatly shaken. The Excellency returned the army to Guāndù. [Yuán] Shào advanced to protect Yángwǔ.  Guān Yǔ deserted to return to Liú Bèi. 
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
二月，紹遣郭圖、淳于瓊、顏良攻東郡太守劉延于白馬，紹引兵至黎陽，將渡河。夏四月，公北救延。荀攸說公曰：「今兵少不敵，分其勢乃可。公到延津，若將渡兵向其後者，紹必西應之，然後輕兵襲白馬，掩其不備，顏良可禽也。」公從之。紹聞兵渡，即分兵西應之。公乃引軍兼行趣白馬，未至十餘里，良大驚，來逆戰。使張遼、關羽前登，擊破，斬良。遂解白馬圍，徙其民，循河而西。紹於是渡河追公軍，至延津南。公勒兵駐營南阪下，使登壘望之，曰；「可五六百騎。」有頃，復白：「騎稍多，步兵不可勝數。」公曰：「勿復白。」乃令騎解鞍放馬。是時，白馬輜重就道。諸將以為敵騎多，不如還保營。荀攸曰：「此所以餌敵，如何去之！」紹騎將文醜與劉備將五六千騎前後至。諸將復白：「可上馬。」公曰：「未也。」有頃，騎至稍多，或分趣輜重。公曰：「可矣。」乃皆上馬。時騎不滿六百，遂縱兵擊，大破之，斬醜。良、醜皆紹名將也，再戰，悉禽，紹軍大震。公還軍官渡。紹進保陽武。關羽亡歸劉備。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Eighth Moon [200 Aug 28 – Sep 25], [Yuán] Shào linked regiments and gradually advanced, used sand piles to make encampments, east to west for several tens of lǐ. The Excellency also divided camps to match them, engaged in battle and was not successful. <a href="#annotation-46" id="source-46">[46]</a> At the time the Excellency’s troops were not even ten thousand, the wounded were two to three out of ten. <a href="#annotation-47" id="source-47">[47]</a> [Yuán] Shào again advanced to face Guāndù, raising earthen mounds and digging tunnels. The Excellency also inside built these in answer. [Yuán] Shào shot into the camps, the arrows falling like rain, anyone walking all covered themselves with shields, the army was greatly afraid.  At the time the Excellency’s provisions were few, and he wrote a letter to Xún Yù discussing a wish to return to Xǔ. [Xún] Yù believed: “[Yuán] Shào has gathered all his multitudes at Guāndù, wishing to with Your Excellency decisively decide victory or defeat. Your Excellency has used the weakest to withstand the strongest. If you cannot resist, you will certainly be overrun. This is the great turning point of Heaven’s Under. Moreover [Yuán] Shào is only a plain clothes leader, able to gather men but unable to employ them. With Your Excellency’s divine martial ability and enlightened wisdom, supported by your great obedience [to Hàn], how can you set forth and not succeed?” The Excellency followed this.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
八月，紹連營稍前，依沙塠為屯，東西數十里。公亦分營與相當，合戰不利。〔一〕時公兵不滿萬，傷者十二三。〔二〕紹復進臨官渡，起土山地道。公亦於內作之，以相應。紹射營中，矢如雨下，行者皆蒙楯，眾大懼。時公糧少，與荀彧書，議欲還許。彧以為「紹悉眾聚官渡，欲與公決勝敗。公以至弱當至彊，若不能制，必為所乘，是天下之大機也。且紹，布衣之雄耳，能聚人而不能用。夫以公之神武明哲而輔以大順，何向而不濟！」公從之。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-46" id="annotation-46">[46]</a> Xí Zuòchǐ’s Hàn Jìn Chūnqiū   states: Xǔ Yōu  advised [Yuán] Shào saying: “Your Excellency need not with [Cáo] Cāo attack one another. Quickly divide the various armies to hold him, and directly take other roads to welcome Heaven’s Son, then the matter can be settled immediately.” [Yuán] Shào did not listen, saying: “I must first surround and take him.” [Xǔ] Yōu was angry.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　羽鑿齒漢晉春秋曰：許攸說紹曰：「公無與操相攻也。急分諸軍持之，而徑從他道迎天子，則事立濟矣。」紹不從，曰：「吾要當先圍取之。」攸怒。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-47" id="annotation-47">[47]</a> Your Servant Sōngzhī believes: Wèi Wǔ [Cáo Cāo] when he first raised troops already had multitudes of five thousand, from then afterward in a hundred battles and a hundred victories, the defeats were two to three out of ten and no more. With only one crushing of the Huángjīn he received a surrender of soldiers of over three hundred thousand, the rest that were absorbed cannot be all recorded. Though in campaigns and battles there are losses, it should yet not be as few as this. The joining of camps to defend one another is different from a breaking charge in decisive battle. The base annals say “[Yuán] Shào’s multitudes were over a hundred thousand, encampments east to west for several tens of lǐ.” Though Wèi Tàizǔ [Cáo Cāo] was adaptable and unpredictable, his strategy unsurpassed in the world, how could he with only a few thousand troops yet be able to resist for so long? Logically speaking I humbly say it is was not so. [Yuán] Shào made encampments for several tens of lǐ, the Excellency was able to divide camps to match them. This is reason one the troops could not be so few. If [Yuán] Shào had multitudes ten times in size, logically he should have used all his strength to encircle and hold, to cut them off from entering and exiting, but it was the Excellency who sent Xú Huǎng  and others to strike their transport carriages, and the Excellency also personally went out to strike Chúnyú Qióng and the rest, raising banners to go out and return, never once obstructed, clearly showing [Yuán] Shào’s strength was unable to restrain it. This is reason two it could not be so few. The various books all say that the Excellency massacred  eighty thousands of [Yuán] Shào’s multitudes, or else say seventy thousand. Eighty thousand men fleeing and scattering is not what eight thousand men would be able to bind. Yet [Yuán] Shào’s great multitudes all held up their hands and went to slaughter; what sort of strength was able to restrain them? This is reason three it could not be so few. Probably the writers of the narration wished to have fewer to appear remarkable and it is not a true record. According to Zhōng Yáo’s biography  it says: “The Excellency with [Yuán] Shào were locked together. [Zhōng] Yáo was Director of Retainers and sent horses of over two thousand to provide for the army.” The base annals and Shìyǔ both say the Excellency at the time had over six hundred cavalry. Where were [Zhōng] Yáo’s horses?
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　臣松之以為魏武初起兵，已有眾五千，自後百戰百勝，敗者十二三而已矣。但一破黃巾，受降卒三十餘萬，餘所吞并，不可悉紀；雖征戰損傷，未應如此之少也。夫結營相守，異於摧鋒決戰。本紀云：「紹眾十餘萬，屯營東西數十里。」魏太祖雖機變無方，略不世出，安有以數千之兵，而得逾時相抗者哉？以理而言，竊謂不然。紹為屯數十里，公能分營與相當，此兵不得甚少，一也。紹若有十倍之眾，理應當悉力圍守，使出入斷絕，而公使徐晃等擊其運車，公又自出擊淳于瓊等，揚旌往還，曾無抵閡，明紹力不能制，是不得甚少，二也。諸書皆云公坑紹眾八萬，或云七萬。夫八萬人奔散，非八千人所能縛，而紹之大眾皆拱手就戮，何緣力能制之？是不得甚少，三也。將記述者欲以少見奇，非其實錄也。按鍾繇傳云：「公與紹相持，繇為司隸，送馬二千餘匹以給軍。」本紀及世語並云公時有騎六百餘匹，繇馬為安在哉？
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Sūn Cè heard that the Excellency with [Yuán] Shào were locked together, and thus plotted to attack Xǔ. Before he set out he was killed by assassins.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
孫策聞公與紹相持，乃謀襲許，未發，為刺客所殺。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Rǔnán’s surrendered bandit Liú Pì  and others rebelled in support of [Yuán] Shào, plundering below Xǔ. [Yuán] Shào sent Liú Bèi to assist [Liú] Pì. The Excellency sent Cáo Rén to strike, defeated them. [Liú] Bèi fled, therefore destroyed [Liú] Pì’s garrison.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
汝南降賊劉辟等叛應紹，略許下。紹使劉備助辟，公使曹仁擊破之。備走，遂破辟屯。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Yuán Shào’s grain transport carriages of several thousand carts arrived. The Excellency used Xún Yōu’s plan and sent Xú Huǎng and Shǐ Huàn to intercept and strike, greatly defeated them, completely burned their carriages. The Excellency with [Yuán] Shào resisted one another for continuous moons. Although in every battle they beheaded officers, however their numbers were few and provisions exhausted, the soldiers weary. The Excellency said to his transporters: “After fifteen days I will have defeated [Yuán] Shào for you, and no longer bother you.”
Winter, Tenth Moon [200 Oct 26 – Nov 23], [Yuán] Shào sent carriages to transport grain, having Chúnyú Qióng and others, five men, command troops of over ten thousand men to escort them, lodging to [Yuán] Shào’s camp’s north by forty lǐ. [Yuán] Shào’s strategy advisor Xǔ Yōu was greedy for wealth, [Yuán] Shào could not satisfy him, he came fleeing  and therefore advised the Excellency to strike [Chúnyú] Qióng and the rest. The Left and Right were suspicious of this, Xún Yōu and Jiǎ Xǔ  encouraged the Excellency. The Excellency thus left Cáo Hóng to defend and personally commanded infantry and cavalry of five thousand men in the night to go. At dawn they arrived. [Chúnyú] Qióng and the rest saw the Excellency’s troops were few, went out and set battle lines outside the gates. The Excellency hurriedly struck them, [Chúnyú] Qióng retreated to protect the camp. Therefore attacked them. [Yuán] Shào sent cavalry to rescue [Chúnyú] Qióng. Of the Left and Right some said: “The rebel cavalry is drawing near, please divide troops to resist them.” The Excellency angrily said: “When the rebels are at our backs then report!” The soldiers all fought to the death, greatly defeated [Chúnyú] Qióng and the rest, beheaded them all. <a href="#annotation-48" id="source-48">[48]</a> When [Yuán] Shào had first heard that the Excellency was striking [Chúnyú] Qióng, he said to his eldest son [Yuán] Tán: “While he attacks [Chúnyú] Qióng and the rest, I will attack and capture his camp, and he will surely have nowhere to return!” Thus he sent Zhāng Hé and Gāo Lǎn  to attack Cáo Hóng. [Zhāng] Hé and the rest heard that [Chúnyú] Qióng was defeated, therefore came to surrender. [Yuán] Shào’s multitudes greatly collapsed. [Yuán] Shào and [Yuán] Tán abandoned the army and fled, crossed the Hé. Pursued them but did not reach them. Completely captured their supply wagons, documents, treasures, took their multitudes as prisoner. <a href="#annotation-49" id="source-49">[49]</a> The Excellency collected [Yuán] Shào’s documents and within them were letters from Xǔ and men in the army. Burned them all. <a href="#annotation-50" id="source-50">[50]</a> Of Jì Province’s various prefectures many opened their cities to surrender.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
袁紹運穀車數千乘至，公用荀攸計，遣徐晃、史渙邀擊，大破之，盡燒其車。公與紹相拒連月，雖比戰斬將，然眾少糧盡，士卒疲乏。公謂運者曰：「卻十五日為汝破紹，不復勞汝矣。」冬十月，紹遣車運穀，使淳于瓊等五人將兵萬餘人送之，宿紹營北四十里。紹謀臣許攸貪財，紹不能足，來奔，因說公擊瓊等。左右疑之，荀攸、賈詡勸公。公乃留曹洪守，自將步騎五千人夜往，會明至。瓊等望見公兵少，出陳門外。公急擊之，瓊退保營，遂攻之。紹遣騎救瓊。左右或言「賊騎稍近，請分兵拒之」。公怒曰：「賊在背後，乃白！」士卒皆殊死戰，大破瓊等，皆斬之。〔一〕紹初聞公之擊瓊，謂長子譚曰：「就彼攻瓊等，吾攻拔其營，彼固無所歸矣！」乃使張郃、高覽攻曹洪。郃等聞瓊破，遂來降。紹眾大潰，紹及譚棄軍走，渡河。追之不及，盡收其輜重圖書珍寶，虜其眾。〔二〕公收紹書中，得許下及軍中人書，皆焚之。〔三〕冀州諸郡多舉城邑降者。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-48" id="annotation-48">[48]</a> Cáo Mán zhuàn states: The Excellency heard that [Xǔ] Yōu had come, and barefooted went out to welcome him,  grasping his hand and laughing, saying: “Zǐyuǎn, you have come, and my matters are resolved!”  When he entered and sat, he said to the Excellency: “Yuán-shì’s army is flourishing. How will you deal with it? Now how much grain is there?” The Excellency said: “It can still last one year.” [Xǔ] Yōu said: “Impossible. Answer again.” Again said: “It can last half a year.” [Xǔ] Yōu said: “Do you sir not wish to defeat Yuán-shì? Why say what is not true?” The Excellency said: “My previous answers were only to tease you. In truth it can last one moon. What is to be done?” [Xǔ] Yōu said: “Your Excellency’s isolated army defends alone, outside there is no rescue, the provisions and grain are already exhausted. This is a dangerous and critical day. Now Yuán-shì’s supply wagons are over ten thousand carts, at Gùshì and Wūcháo,  the garrison armies are not strict or prepared. Now use light troops to attack them, arrive unexpectedly, burn their accumulated stores, and in no more than three days Yuán-shì will on his own be defeated.” The Excellency was greatly pleased, thus selected elite infantry and cavalry,  all using Yuán army banners and flags, tying gags on the mouths of the horses, in the night following the side roads, each man carrying a bundle of firewood, and whenever someone they passed on the road asked, they said to them: “Yuán-gōng  fears Cáo Cāo will raid and plunder the rear army, and sends troops to increase preparations.” Those who heard believed it was true and all were self-composed. They arrived, besieged the garrison, greatly set fires, the inside of the camp was alarmed and in chaos. Greatly defeated them, completely burned their provisions and grain and treasures, cut off the heads of supervising officer Suī Yuánjìn, cavalry supervisors Hán Jǔzǐ, Lǚ Wēihuáng, Zhào Ruì, and others.  Cut off the nose of General Chúnyú Zhòngjiǎn,  though he was not dead. Killed soldiers of over a thousand men, all taking the noses, and cut off the lips and tongues of oxen and horses, to show to [Yuán] Shào’s army, and their officers and soldiers were all shocked and frightened. At that time in the night captured [Chúnyú] Zhòngjiǎn, leading him to bring him below the banner. The Excellency said: “How did it come to this?” [Chúnyú] Zhòngjiǎn said: “Victory and defeat is decided by Heaven. What use is there in asking?” The Excellency’s intention was not to kill him. Xǔ Yōu said: “Tomorrow morning he will look in the mirror. This is a man who will all the more not forget this.” Therefore killed him.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　曹瞞傳曰：公聞攸來，跣出迎之，撫掌笑曰：「（子卿遠）〔子遠，卿〕來，吾事濟矣！」既入坐，謂公曰：「袁氏軍盛，何以待之？今有幾糧乎？」公曰：「尚可支一歲。」攸曰：「無是，更言之！」又曰：「可支半歲。」攸曰：「足下不欲破袁氏邪，何言之不實也！」公曰：「向言戲之耳。其實可一月，為之柰何？」攸曰：「公孤軍獨守，外無救援而糧穀已盡，此危急之日也。今袁氏輜重有萬餘乘，在故市、烏巢，屯軍無嚴備；今以輕兵襲之，不意而至，燔其積聚，不過三日，袁氏自敗也。」公大喜，乃選精銳步騎，皆用袁軍旗幟，銜枚縛馬口，夜從間道出，人抱束薪，所歷道有問者，語之曰：「袁公恐曹操鈔略後軍，遣兵以益備。」聞者信以為然，皆自若。既至，圍屯，大放火，營中驚亂。大破之，盡燔其糧穀寶貨，斬督將眭元進、騎督韓莒子、呂威璜、趙叡等首，割得將軍淳于仲簡鼻，未死，殺士卒千餘人，皆取鼻，牛馬割唇舌，以示紹軍。將士皆怛懼。時有夜得仲簡，將以詣麾下，公謂曰：「何為如是？」仲簡曰：「勝負自天，何用為問乎！」公意欲不殺。許攸曰：「明旦鑒于鏡，此益不忘人。」乃殺之。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-49" id="annotation-49">[49]</a> Xiàn-dì Qǐjū zhù  states: The Excellency sent up report: “General-in-Chief and Marquess of Yè,  Yuán Shào, formerly with Jì Province Governor Hán Fù established former Marshal-in-Chief  Liú Yú, carved a gold Ruler’s Seal, and sent former Rèn Chief Bì Yú  to visit [Liú] Yú to persuade him of the calculations of the Mandate to rule. Also [Yuán] Shào wrote to Your Servant  a letter that said: “Juànchéng can be the capital, there will be an establishment.” He usurped authority to cast gold and silver seals, Filial-Incorruptible and calculations officials all went to join [Yuán] Shào. His younger cousin Jǐyīn Administrator [Yuán] Xù  sent [Yuán] Shào a letter that said: “Now Within the Seas is declined and ruined, Heaven’s intentions truly are on our family. The spirits answer with signs that are precisely on you, Honored Elder Brother. The subordinates of Southern Elder Brother [Yuán Shù] wished to have him ascend the throne, but Southern Elder Brother said that in years of age then you Northern Elder Brother are senior, and in rank then you Northern Elder Brother are greater, and so wished to send you the Ruler’s Seal.  It happened that Cáo Cāo cut off the roads.” [Yuán] Shào’s clan for accumulated generations received the state’s heavy favor,   but yet he is a Vicious Rebel Without Principles, thus reaching as far as this. At once reining in troops and horses, battled with him at Guāndù, riding on the prestige of the Sagely Court, captured and cut off the heads of [Yuán] Shào’s chief officers Chúnyú Qióng and others of eight men, and therefore greatly defeated and scattered them. [Yuán] Shào with his son [Yuán] Tán alone escaped and fled. Altogether beheaded over seventy thousand, captured supply wagons and baggage of tremendous numbers.”
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　獻帝起居注曰：公上言「大將軍鄴侯袁紹前與冀州牧韓馥立故大司馬劉虞，刻作金璽，遣故任長畢瑜詣虞，為說命錄之數。又紹與臣書云：『可都鄄城，當有所立。』擅鑄金銀印，孝廉計吏，皆往詣紹。從弟濟陰太守敘與紹書云：『今海內喪敗，天意實在我家，神應有徵，當在尊兄。南兄臣下欲使即位，南兄言，以年則北兄長，以位則北兄重。便欲送璽，會曹操斷道。』紹宗族累世受國重恩，而凶逆無道，乃至于此。輒勒兵馬，與戰官渡，乘聖朝之威，得斬紹大將淳于瓊等八人首，遂大破潰。紹與子譚輕身迸走。凡斬首七萬餘級，輜重財物巨億。」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-50" id="annotation-50">[50]</a> Wèishì Chūnqiū states: The Excellency said: “When [Yuán] Shào was powerful, even I could not protect myself, so all the more for everyone else!”
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔三〕　魏氏春秋曰：公云：「當紹之彊，孤猶不能自保，而況眾人乎！」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Previously, in Emperor Huán’s time there was a yellow star sighted in the division of Chǔ and Sòng.  Liáodōng’s Yīn Kuí <a href="#annotation-51" id="source-51">[51]</a> excelled in Astrology, and said after fifty years there would be a True Man  rising between Liáng and Pèi, his advance unstoppable. From then altogether was fifty years, and then the Excellency defeated [Yuán] Shào, Under Heaven none could match him.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
初，桓帝時有黃星見于楚、宋之分，遼東殷馗〔一〕善天文，言後五十歲當有真人起于梁、沛之間，其鋒不可當。至是凡五十年，而公破紹，天下莫敵矣。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-51" id="annotation-51">[51]</a> Kuí is the ancient character for Kuí. See Sāncāng.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　馗，古逵字，見三蒼。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Sixth Year, Summer, Fourth Moon [201 May 20 – Jun 18], raised troops up the Hé, struck [Yuán] Shào’s Cāngtíng army, defeated them.  [Yuán] Shào returned home, again collected his scattered soldiers, attacked and settled the various rebelling prefectures and counties.
Ninth Moon [201 Oct 15 – Nov 13], the Excellency returned to Xǔ. When [Yuán] Shào had not yet been defeated, he sent Liú Bèi to plunder Rǔnán, and Rǔnán bandit Gòng Dū  and others supported him. Sent Cài Yáng  to strike [Gòng] Dū, unsuccessful, defeated by [Gòng] Dū. The Excellency campaigned south against [Liú] Bèi. [Liú] Bèi heard that the Excellency was personally going and fled to Liú Biǎo, [Gòng] Dū and the rest all scattered.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
六年夏四月，揚兵河上，擊紹倉亭軍，破之。紹歸，復收散卒，攻定諸叛郡縣。九月，公還許。紹之未破也，使劉備略汝南，汝南賊共都等應之。遣蔡揚擊都，不利，為都所破。公南征備。備聞公自行，走奔劉表，都等皆散。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Seventh Year, Spring, Standard Moon [202 Feb 10 – Mar 11], the Excellency’s army at Qiáo, his Order said: “I raised Righteous Troops to eliminate brutality and chaos for Heaven’s Under. The people of my homeland have almost completely died out. In the state I travel to end of day and do not see anyone I recognize, causing me heartrending grief. Thus from since this raising of Righteous Troops, of the officers and soldiers without descendants, seek their relatives to serve as their heirs, bestow land and farms, government provided plowing oxen, install schools to educate them. For the surviving establish temples, to allow them to sacrifice to their ancestors. If the souls yet have awareness, after my Hundred Years  what regrets would there be?” Therefore reached Jùnyí, repaired Suīyáng Canal, sent envoy to offer Grand Offering as sacrifice to Qiáo Xuán. <a href="#annotation-52" id="source-52">[52]</a> Advanced the army to Guāndù.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
七年春正月，公軍譙，令曰：「吾起義兵，為天下除暴亂。舊土人民，死喪略盡，國中終日行，不見所識，使吾悽愴傷懷。其舉義兵已來，將士絕無後者，求其親戚以後之，授土田，官給耕牛，置學師以教之。為存者立廟，使祀其先人，魂而有靈，吾百年之後何恨哉！」遂至浚儀，治睢陽渠，遣使以太牢祀橋玄。〔一〕進軍官渡。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-52" id="annotation-52">[52]</a> Bāoshǎng Lìng  records the Excellency’s Sacrifical Text stating: Former Grand Commandant Qiáo-gōng thoroughly spread enlightenment and virtue, generous with affection and extensive in tolerance. The state remembers his enlightened admonishments, servicemen ponder his virtuous practices. His spirit is departed and body buried, oh far away from the sun! In my childhood years I visited and ascended his halls and rooms, and despite my obstinate and lowly nature was accepted by the great noble man.  My increase in honor and rise in fame was all by his encouragement and assistance, like how Zhòngní said he did not compare to Yán Yuān, and Lǐ Shēng generously sighed of Jiǎ Fù.  The serviceman dies for the one who understands him.  I remember this without ever forgetting. Also I convey the words of a casual pledge: ‘After I pass away, if you pass by on the road and do not offer a bottle of alcohol and a chicken in libation, after your carriage passes three bù,  do not be bewildered when your stomach aches!’ Though these words were a joke and a laugh at that time, if it was not the sincere friendship of utmost closeness, how could he have made this statement? I do not say that your spirit’s anger is able to cause me illness. Only for old feelings do I look back, remembering it in sorrow. Receiving orders to campaign east, garrisoning and stopping at my hometown, looking northward to your noble lands, then my heart is at your tomb. Delivering these meager libations, may Your Excellency enjoy it!”
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　褒賞令載公祀文曰：「故太尉橋公，誕敷明德，汎愛博容。國念明訓，士思令謨。靈幽體翳，邈哉晞矣！吾以幼年，逮升堂室，特以頑鄙之姿，為大君子所納。增榮益觀，皆由獎助，猶仲尼稱不如顏淵，李生之厚歎賈復。士死知己，懷此無忘。又承從容約誓之言：『殂逝之後，路有經由，不以斗酒隻雞過相沃酹，車過三步，腹痛勿怪！』雖臨時戲笑之言，非至親之篤好，胡肯為此辭乎？匪謂靈忿，能詒己疾，懷舊惟顧，念之悽愴。奉命東征，屯次鄉里，北望貴土，乃心陵墓。裁致薄奠，公其尚饗！」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
[Yuán] Shào, from since his army was defeated, fell ill and spat blood. Summer, Fifth Moon [202 Jun 8 – Jul 7] he died. His youngest son [Yuán] Shàng succeeded. [Yuán] Tán declared himself Chariots and Cavalry General, garrisoned Líyáng. 
Autumn, Ninth Moon [202 Oct 4 – Nov 2], the Excellency campaigned against them, fighting successive battles. [Yuán] Tán and [Yuán] Shàng were repeatedly defeated and retreated, and firmly defended.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
紹自軍破後，發病歐血，夏五月死。小子尚代，譚自號車騎將軍，屯黎陽。秋九月，公征之，連戰。譚、尚數敗退，固守。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Eighth Year, Spring, Third Moon [203 Mar 31 – Apr 28], attacked their outer walls, thus they came out to battle. Struck, greatly defeated them. [Yuán] Tán and [Yuán] Shàng in the night fled.
Summer, Fourth Moon [203 Apr 29 – May 28], advanced the army to Yè.
Fifth Moon [203 May 29 – Jun 26], returned to Xǔ, leaving Jiǎ Xìn to garrison Líyáng.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
八年春三月，攻其郭，乃出戰，擊，大破之，譚、尚夜遁。夏四月，進軍鄴。五月還許，留賈信屯黎陽。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Jǐyǒu [203 Jun 22], his Order said: “The Sīmǎ Fǎ:  ‘Generals die on appeasing,’ <a href="#annotation-53" id="source-53">[53]</a> and therefore Zhào Kuò’s mother begged to not be connected to [Zhào] Kuò.  This was because for the officers of antiquity, when the army was defeated outside, then their families were punished inside. From since I have commanded campaigns, I have only rewarded achievements and not punished crimes, and this is not the state’s canon. Thus order that for the various officers going on campaign, those that ruin the army are to be punished for the crime, and those who are unsuccessful to be stripped of office and noble rank.” <a href="#annotation-54" id="source-54">[54]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
己酉，令曰：「司馬法『將軍死綏』，〔一〕故趙括之母，乞不坐括。是古之將者，軍破于外，而家受罪于內也。自命將征行，但賞功而不罰罪，非國典也。其令諸將出征，敗軍者抵罪，失利者免官爵。」〔二〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-53" id="annotation-53">[53]</a> Wèi shū states: Appeasing means retreating. There can be advancing one chǐ, never retreating one cùn.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏書曰：綏，卻也。有前一尺，無卻一寸。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-54" id="annotation-54">[54]</a> Wèi shū records the Gēngshēn [203 Jul 3] Order: “Of the commentators some believe that although the army officials have achievements and ability, their virtue and conduct are not sufficient to be chosen to receive appointment in the prefectures and states, what is called: ‘Can adhere to principles, cannot be given authority.’  Guǎn Zhòng said: ‘Have the worthy fed for ability and then the superior is honored, fighting servicemen fed for achievement and then the soldiers think little of death. When these two are established in the state then Heaven’s Under is governed.’  One has never heard of men without ability and servicemen who do not fight all receiving salary and rewards, that can yet then establish achievement and invigorate the state. Therefore an enlightened lord does not give office to ministers without achievements and does not reward servicemen who do not battle. In governing peace esteem virtue and conduct, when having problems reward achievement and ability. The words of the discussions are all looking at a tiger through a tube!”
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　魏書載庚申令曰：「議者或以軍吏雖有功能，德行不足堪任郡國之選，所謂『可與適道，未可與權』。管仲曰：『使賢者食於能則上尊，鬥士食於功則卒輕于死，二者設於國則天下治。』未聞無能之人，不鬥之士，並受祿賞，而可以立功興國者也。故明君不官無功之臣，不賞不戰之士；治平尚德行，有事賞功能。論者之言，一似管窺虎歟！」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Autumn, Seventh Moon [203 Aug 25 – Sep 23], his Order said: “From since the decline and chaos, it has been ten and five years. Those born later have not seen customs of benevolence and righteousness and courtesy and deference. I am extremely pained by this. Thus order the prefectures and states to each cultivate literary scholarship, counties with at least five hundred households are to install school officials, to select the eminent from their hometowns and educate them, so that the principles of the former kings will not be lost, and yet have benefits for Heaven’s Under.”
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
秋七月，令曰：「喪亂已來，十有五年，後生者不見仁義禮讓之風，吾甚傷之。其令郡國各脩文學，縣滿五百戶置校官，選其鄉之俊造而教學之，庶幾先王之道不廢，而有以益于天下。」
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Eighth Moon [203 Sep 24 – Oct 22], the Excellency campaigned against Liú Biǎo, the army at Xīpíng.  When the Excellency had left Yè and gone south, [Yuán] Tán and [Yuán] Shàng fought over Jì Province. [Yuán] Tàn was defeated by [Yuán] Shàng and fled to protect Píngyuán. [Yuán] Shàng attacked him fiercely. [Yuán] Tán sent Xīn Pí  to beg to surrender and request rescue. The various officers were all suspicious. Xún Yōu encouraged the Excellency to agree to it, <a href="#annotation-55" id="source-55">[55]</a> and the Excellency thus led the army back.
Winter, Tenth Moon [203 Nov 22 – Dec 20], arrived at Líyáng, and used his son [Cáo] Zhěng to arrange a marriage alliance with [Yuán] Tán. <a href="#annotation-56" id="source-56">[56]</a> [Yuán] Shàng heard that the Excellency had gone north, and thus released Píngyuán and returned to Yè. Dōngpíng’s Lǚ Kuàng and Lǚ Xiáng rebelled against [Yuán] Shàng, garrisoned Yángpíng,  led their multitudes to surrender, enfeoffed as Ranked Marquesses. <a href="#annotation-57" id="source-57">[57]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
八月，公征劉表，軍西平。公之去鄴而南也，譚、尚爭冀州，譚為尚所敗，走保平原。尚攻之急，譚遣辛毗乞降請救。諸將皆疑，荀攸勸公許之，〔一〕公乃引軍還。冬十月，到黎陽，為子整與譚結婚。〔二〕尚聞公北，乃釋平原還鄴。東平呂曠、呂翔叛尚，屯陽平，率其眾降，封為列侯。〔三〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-55" id="annotation-55">[55]</a> Wèi shū states: The Excellency said: “When I attacked Lǚ Bù, [Liú] Biǎo did not raid. In the Guāndù campaign, he did not rescue [Yuán] Shào. This is a rebel who only defends himself. It is appropriate to deal with him later. [Yuán] Tán and [Yuán] Shàng are cunning, and we should take advantage of their discord. Even if [Yuán] Tán harbors deceit and will not bind hands in the end, it will allow us defeat to [Yuán] Shàn, first seize his territory, the benefits assuredly will be many.” Thus he agreed to it.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏書曰：公云：「我攻呂布，表不為寇，官渡之役，不救袁紹，此自守之賊也，宜為後圖。譚、尚狡猾，當乘其亂。縱譚挾詐，不終束手，使我破尚，偏收其地，利自多矣。」乃許之。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-56" id="annotation-56">[56]</a> Your Servant Sōngzhī notes: From [Yuán] Shào’s death to this was not more a year and five moons. Though [Yuán] Tán was sent out to be the descendant for his senior uncle and would not observe three years mourning for [Yuán] Shào, to yet within that the second anniversary enact a joyous ceremony is incredibly perverse. Wèi Wǔ perhaps for expedience made a pledge with him, and though it says marriage, it was not necessarily completed in this year.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　臣松之案：紹死至此，過周五月耳。譚雖出後其伯，不為紹服三年，而於再期之內以行吉禮，悖矣。魏武或以權宜與之約言；今云結婚，未必便以此年成禮。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-57" id="annotation-57">[57]</a> Wèi shū states: When [Yuán] Tán’s besiegement was lifted, he secretly had Generals’ seals and ribbons lent to [Lǚ] Kuàng. [Lǚ] Kuàng received the seals and sent them [to report them]. The Excellency said: “I always knew [Yuán] Tán had some small plot. He wishes to have me attack [Yuán] Shàng, to be able to in the interim plunder people and raise multitudes, and at [Yuán] Shàng’s defeat, be able to strengthen himself to take advantage of our weariness. [But when Yuán] Shàng is defeated we will flourish, and what weariness is there to take advantage of?”
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔三〕　魏書曰：譚之圍解，陰以將軍印綬假曠。曠受印送之，公曰：「我固知譚之有小計也。欲使我攻尚，得以其閒略民聚眾，尚之破，可得自彊以乘我弊也。尚破我盛，何弊之乘乎？」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Ninth Year, Spring, Standard Moon [204 Feb 18 – Mar 18], crossed the Hé, redirected the Qí river to enter the Bái canal to connect a supply line. 
Second Moon [204 Mar 19 – Apr 17], [Yuán] Shàng again attacked [Yuán] Tán, leaving Sū Yóu and Shěn Pèi to defend Yè.  The Excellency advanced the army to arrive at Huán river. [Sū] Yóu surrendered. When he arrived, attacked Yè, building earthen mounds and digging tunnels. Wǔ’ān Chief Yǐn Kǎi garrisoned Máochéng, connecting Shàngdǎng supply lines [into Yè]. 
Summer, Fourth Moon [204 May 17 – Jun 15], left Cáo Hóng to attack Yè, the Excellency personally commanded the strike on [Yǐn] Kǎi, defeated him and returned. [Yuán] Shàng’s officer Jū Hú defended Hándān, <a href="#annotation-58" id="source-58">[58]</a> also struck and captured it. Yìyáng Magistrate Hán Fàn and Shè Chief Liáng Qí led their counties to surrender, bestowed noble rank as Within the Passes Marquesses.
Fifth Moon [204 Jun 16 – Jul 14], demolished the earthen mounds and tunnels, built an encircling moat, breached the Zhāng river to flood the city. Inside the city the dead from starvation were over half. 
Autumn, Seventh Moon [204 Aug 14 – Sep 11], [Yuán] Shàng returned to rescue Yè. The various officers all believed: “This is a brigade returning home, the men fighting for themselves. It is better to avoid them.” The Excellency said: “[If Yuán] Shàng comes by the main road, we should avoid them. If they follow the western mountains to come, this is only to complete their capture.” [Yuán] Shàng indeed followed the western mountains to come, faced the Fǔ river to make camp. <a href="#annotation-59" id="source-59">[59]</a> In the night sent troops to break the siege. The Excellency opposed and struck and defeated and drove them away, and therefore besieged his camp. Before complete encirclement, [Yuán] Shàng was afraid, and sent former Yù Province Inspector Yīn Kuí with Chén Lín  to ask to surrender. The Excellency did not accept, and increased the pressure of the siege. [Yuán] Shàng in the night escaped, protected Qíshān.  Pursued and struck him, his officers Mǎ Yán, Zhāng Yǐ, and others  while facing the battle lines surrendered, his multitudes greatly collapsed apart. [Yuán] Shàng fled to Zhōngshān.  Completely captured his supply wagons, obtained [Yuán] Shàng’s Seal and Ribbon and Stave and Battle-Ax, had [Yuán] Shàng’s surrendered men show these to his family, and the city interior collapsed apart.
Eighth Moon [204 Sep 12 – Oct 11], Shěn Pèi’s elder brother’s son [Shěn] Róng  in the night opened the city’s east gate that he was defending to let inside the troops. [Shěn] Pèi opposed in battle, defeated. Captured alive [Shěn] Pèi, beheaded him.  Yè was settled. The Excellency oversaw sacrifices at [Yuán] Shào’s tomb, wept and shed tears, gave consolations to [Yuán] Shào’s wife, returned their family servants and treasures, bestowed miscellaneous silk and cloth, government grain to feed her. <a href="#annotation-60" id="source-60">[60]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
九年春正月，濟河，遏淇水入白溝以通糧道。二月，尚復攻譚，留蘇由、審配守鄴。公進軍到洹水，由降。既至，攻鄴，為土山、地道。武安長尹楷屯毛城，通上黨糧道。夏四月，留曹洪攻鄴，公自將擊楷，破之而還。尚將沮鵠守邯鄲，〔一〕又擊拔之。易陽令韓範、涉長梁岐舉縣降，賜爵關內侯。五月，毀土山、地道，作圍塹，決漳水灌城；城中餓死者過半。秋七月，尚還救鄴，諸將皆以為「此歸師，人自為戰，不如避之」。公曰：「尚從大道來，當避之；若循西山來者，此成禽耳。」尚果循西山來，臨滏水為營。〔二〕夜遣兵犯圍，公逆擊破走之，遂圍其營。未合，尚懼，〔遣〕故豫州刺史陰夔及陳琳乞降，公不許，為圍益急。尚夜遁，保祁山，追擊之。其將馬延、張顗等臨陳降，眾大潰，尚走中山。盡獲其輜重，得尚印綬節鉞，使尚降人示其家，城中崩沮。八月，審配兄子榮夜開所守城東門內兵。配逆戰，敗，生禽配，斬之，鄴定。公臨祀紹墓，哭之流涕；慰勞紹妻，還其家人寶物，賜雜繒絮，廩食之。〔三〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-58" id="annotation-58">[58]</a> Jū pronounced Zū. Around Héshuò there is still this surname. [Jū] Hú was Jū Shòu’s son.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　沮音菹，河朔閒今猶有此姓。鵠，沮授子也。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-59" id="annotation-59">[59]</a> Cáo Mán zhuàn states: Sent scouts of several divisions beginning to end to watch them. All said: “They are definitely following the west road, already at Hándān.” The Excellency was greatly pleased, gathered the various officers and said: “I have already obtained Jì Province, do you sirs know of it?” All said: “No.” The Excellency said: “You sirs will see before long.”
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　曹瞞傳曰：遣候者數部前後參之，皆曰「定從西道，已在邯鄲」。公大喜，會諸將曰：「孤已得冀州，諸君知之乎？」皆曰：「不知。」公曰：「諸君方見不久也。」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-60" id="annotation-60">[60]</a> Sūn Shèng says: In the past the former kings made punishments and rewards in order to discourage evil and encourage goodness, a perpetually clear reflection and warning. [Yuán] Shào took advantage of the world’s distress and endangerment, therefore harbored treacherous plots, above discussing the Divine Vessels,  below violating the state’s coherence. Offering sacrifices and cleaning tombs are an ancient regulation, but to then be thorough in grief at the burial mound of a rebel minister and apply kindness on a gluttonous household, in the principles of governance, this is a misstep. To hide resentment to befriend someone is what former sages were disgusted by.  Unharnessing horses at a former lodging, by righteousness there should be no false tears.  If the paths taken diverge and friendship is severed, what weeping is to be had? In the past Hàn Gāo had this failing with Xiàng-shì.  Wèi Wǔ followed the error in this action. How as it not the one failing out of a hundred considerations?
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔三〕　孫盛云：昔者先王之為誅賞也，將以懲惡勸善，永彰鑒戒。紹因世艱危，遂懷逆謀，上議神器，下干國紀。荐社汙宅，古之制也，而乃盡哀于逆臣之冢，加恩于饕餮之室，為政之道，於斯躓矣。夫匿怨友人，前哲所恥，稅驂舊館，義無虛涕，苟道乖好絕，何哭之有！昔漢高失之於項氏，魏武遵謬於此舉，豈非百慮之一失也。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Previously, when [Yuán] Shào and the Excellency together raised troops, [Yuán] Shào asked the Excellency: “If the task is not successful, then what region could be occupied?” The Excellency said: “What do you think of it?” [Yuán] Shào said: “I would to the south occupy the Hé, to the north fortify Yān and Dài, absorb the multitudes of the Róng and Dí.  Heading south to contest Heaven’s Under, who could resist?” The Excellency said: “I would appoint the intelligent and capable of Heaven’s Under, by principles leading them, nothing would be impossible.” <a href="#annotation-61" id="source-61">[61]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
初，紹與公共起兵，紹問公曰：「若事不輯，則方面何所可據？」公曰：「足下意以為何如？」紹曰：「吾南據河，北阻燕、代，兼戎狄之眾，南向以爭天下，庶可以濟乎？」公曰：「吾任天下之智力，以道御之，無所不可。」〔一〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-61" id="annotation-61">[61]</a> Fù-zǐ  states: Tàizǔ also said: “Did Tāng and Wǔ as Kings have the same territory?  If one only uses terrain as the resource, then one would not be able to answer opportunities and make changes.”
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　傅子曰：太祖又云：「湯、武之王，豈同土哉？若以險固為資，則不能應機而變化也。」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Ninth Moon [204 Oct 12 – Nov 9], Order said: “The Hé’s north suffered from the hardships of the Yuán clan. Thus order to not pay this year’s taxes.”  Increased the laws against the powerful and strong taking over [land], the Hundred Surnames were pleased and joyous. <a href="#annotation-62" id="source-62">[62]</a> Heaven’s Son appointed the Excellency as designate Jì Province Governor, the Excellency yielded and returned Yǎn Province.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
九月，令曰：「河北罹袁氏之難，其令無出今年租賦！」重豪彊兼并之法，百姓喜悅。〔一〕天子以公領冀州牧，公讓還兗州。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-62" id="annotation-62">[62]</a> Wèi shū records the Excellency’s Order stating: “’Those with state and with family do not fear scarcity but fear uneven distribution, do not fear poverty but fear lack of security.’  The governance of the Yuán clan allowed the powerful and strong to usurp authority and act unrestrained, family and relations taking over [land]. The lower classes were poor and weak, were made to substitute for them in paying taxes, forced to sell off family property, but it was not enough to fulfill the demands. Shěn Pèi’s clan went as far as to give shelter to criminals, becoming a host for fugitives. Wishing and hoping for the Hundred Surnames to be close and attached, the armored soldiers to be strong and flourishing, how can it be obtained [like this]? Thus the collected farm tax per mǔ is four shēng, per household is cloth of two pǐ, silk floss of two jīn  and nothing more. Others are not to usurp authority to collect more. The prefecture administrators and state chancellors are to clearly investigate this, to not allow the strong to have concealments and the weak to be double taxed.”
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏書載公令曰：「有國有家者，不患寡而患不均，不患貧而患不安。袁氏之治也，使豪彊擅恣，親戚兼并；下民貧弱，代出租賦，衒鬻家財，不足應命；審配宗族，至乃藏匿罪人，為逋逃主。欲望百姓親附，甲兵彊盛，豈可得邪！其收田租畝四升，戶出絹二匹、綿二斤而已，他不得擅興發。郡國守相明檢察之，無令彊民有所隱藏，而弱民兼賦也。」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
When the Excellency besieged Yè, [Yuán] Tán captured and took Gānlíng, Ānpíng, Bóhǎi, Héjiān.  [Yuán] Shàng was defeated and returned to Zhōngshān. [Yuán] Tán attacked him. [Yuán] Shàng fled to Gù’ān,  therefore [Yuán Tán] absorbed his multitudes. The Excellency sent [Yuán] Tán a letter, reprimanding him for betraying their pact, severed the marriage alliance with him, sent back his daughter, and afterward advanced the army. [Yuán] Tán was afraid, evacuated Píngyuán, and fled to protect Nánpí. 
Twelfth Moon [205 Jan 8 – Feb 6], the Excellency entered Píngyuán, capturing and settling the various counties.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
公之圍鄴也，譚略取甘陵、安平、勃海、河間。尚敗，還中山。譚攻之，尚奔故安，遂并其眾。公遺譚書，責以負約，與之絕婚，女還，然後進軍。譚懼，拔平原，走保南皮。十二月，公入平原，略定諸縣。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Tenth Year, Spring, Standard Moon [205 Feb 7 – Mar 7], attacked [Yuán] Tán, defeated him. Beheaded [Yuán] Tán, executed his wives and children.  Jì Province was settled. <a href="#annotation-63" id="source-63">[63]</a> The sent down Order said: “Those who with the Yuán clan together did evil will be permitted to restart anew.” Ordered the people to not be able to take private revenge, forbade lavish burial, all unified under law. That moon, Yuán Xī’s chief officers Jiāo Chù, Zhāng Nán, and others rebelled against and attacked [Yuán] Xī and [Yuán] Shàng.  [Yuán] Xī and [Yuán] Shàng fled to the Three Prefectures Wūhuán.  [Jiāo] Chù and the rest led the counties to surrender, and were enfeoffed as Ranked Marquesses. Previously at the time of the suppression of [Yuán] Tán, some people deserted from ice breaking, <a href="#annotation-64" id="source-64">[64]</a> and it was ordered to not allow surrenders. Shortly after this, of the deserters there was one who came to the gates to turn himself in. The Excellency said: “Sparing you then would violate orders, killing you then would be to punish turning oneself in. Return back into hiding, and do not let officials capture you.” The person shed tears and left. Later he was indeed captured.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
十年春正月，攻譚，破之，斬譚，誅其妻子，冀州平。〔一〕下令曰：「其與袁氏同惡者，與之更始。」令民不得復私讎，禁厚葬，皆一之于法。　是月，袁熙大將焦觸、張南等叛攻熙、尚，熙、尚奔三郡烏丸。觸等舉其縣降，封為列侯。初討譚時，民亡椎冰，〔二〕令不得降。頃之，亡民有詣門首者，公謂曰：「聽汝則違令，殺汝則誅首，歸深自藏，無為吏所獲。」民垂泣而去；後竟捕得。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-63" id="annotation-63">[63]</a> Wèi shū states: The Excellency attacked [Yuán] Tán. From dawn to midday it was not decided. The Excellency thus personally beat the drums, the soldiers all exerted themselves, and immediately broke through.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏書曰：公攻譚，旦及日中不決；公乃自執桴鼓，士卒咸奮，應時破陷。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-64" id="annotation-64">[64]</a> Your Servant Sōngzhī believes: At the time of suppressing [Yuán] Tán, the streams and canals were frozen, people were sent to break the ice for ships to pass through, but the people hated the labor and deserted.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　臣松之以為討譚時，川渠水凍，使民椎冰以通船，民憚役而亡。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Summer, Fourth Moon [205 May 6 – Jun 4], Hēishān bandit Zhāng Yàn  led his multitudes of over one hundred thousand to surrender, enfeoffed as a Ranked Marquess. Gù’ān’s Zhào Dù, Huò Nú, and others killed the Yōu Province Inspector and Zhuō Prefecture Administrator.  The Three Prefectures Wūhuán attacked Xiānyú Fǔ at Guăngpíng. <a href="#annotation-65" id="source-65">[65]</a> Autumn, Eighth Moon [205 Sep 2 – Sep 30], the Excellency campaigned against them, beheaded [Zhào] Dú and others, and thus crossed the Lù river  to relieve Guǎngpíng. The Wūhuán fled beyond the passes.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
夏四月，黑山賊張燕率其眾十餘萬降，封為列侯。故安趙犢、霍奴等殺幽州刺史、涿郡太守。三郡烏丸攻鮮于輔於獷平。〔一〕秋八月，公征之，斬犢等，乃渡潞河救獷平，烏丸奔走出塞。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-65" id="annotation-65">[65]</a> Xù Hàn shū’s Jùn Guó zhì  states: Guǎngpíng is a county name, part of Yúyáng prefecture.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　續漢書郡國志曰：獷平，縣名，屬漁陽郡。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Ninth Moon [205 Oct 1 – Oct 30], Order said: “Partisanship and collusion are what the former sages hated. It is heard that in Jì Province’s customs, fathers and sons in separate departments spread blame and praise to support one another. In the past Zhí Bùyí had no elder brothers and yet the people of the time said that he stole his elder brother’s wife;  Dìwǔ Bóyú’s three marriages were with orphaned girls and yet they said that he beat his wives’ fathers;  Wáng Fèng usurped power yet Gǔ Yǒng compared him to Shēn Bó;  Wáng Shāng was loyal in his commentary yet Zhāng Kuāng said he was heretical.  These all were taking white as black, cheating Heaven and deceiving lord. I wish to bring order to social customs. If these four are not abolished, I will be ashamed.”
Winter, Tenth Moon [205 Oct 31 – Nov 28], the Excellency returned to Yè.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
九月，令曰：「阿黨比周，先聖所疾也。聞冀州俗，父子異部，更相毀譽。昔直不疑無兄，世人謂之盜嫂；第五伯魚三娶孤女，謂之撾婦翁；王鳳擅權，谷永比之申伯，王商忠議，張匡謂之左道：此皆以白為黑，欺天罔君者也。吾欲整齊風俗，四者不除，吾以為羞。」冬十月，公還鄴。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Previously, Yuán Shào appointed his sister’s son Gāo Gàn as designate Bìng Province Governor.  When the Excellency captured Yè, [Gāo] Gàn surrendered, and therefore was appointed Inspector. [Gāo] Gàn heard that the Excellency was suppressing the Wūhuán, and so led his province in rebellion, seized the Shàngdǎng Administrator, raised troops to defend Húguānkǒu.  Sent Yuè Jìn and Lǐ Diǎn to strike him. [Gāo] Gàn returned to defend Húguān city. Eleventh Year, Spring, Standard Moon [206 Jan 27 – Feb 25], the Excellency campaigned against [Gāo] Gàn. [Gāo] Gàn heard this, and so left his separate officers to defend the city, fled into the Xiōngnú, requesting rescue from the Chányú. The Chányú would not receive him. The Excellency besieged Húguān for three moons, captured it. [Gāo] Gàn therefore fled to Jīng Province. Shàngluò Commandant Wáng Yǎn captured and beheaded him.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
初，袁紹以甥高幹領并州牧，公之拔鄴，幹降，遂以為刺史。幹聞公討烏丸，乃以州叛，執上黨太守，舉兵守壺關口。遣樂進、李典擊之，幹還守壺關城。十一年春正月，公征幹。幹聞之，乃留其別將守城，走入匈奴，求救於單于，單于不受。公圍壺關三月，拔之。幹遂走荊州，上洛都尉王琰捕斬之。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Autumn, Eighth Moon [206 Sep 20 – Oct 19], the Excellency campaigned east against sea pirate Guǎn Chéng, reached Chúnyú, sent Yuè Jìn and Lǐ Diǎn to strike, defeated him, [Guǎn] Chéng fled to a sea island.  Divided out from Dōnghǎi [prefecture] Xiāngbēn, Tán, and Qí [counties] to add to Lángyé [prefecture], abolished Chānglǜ prefecture. <a href="#annotation-66" id="source-66">[66]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
秋八月，公東征海賊管承，至淳于，遣樂進、李典擊破之，承走入海島。割東海之襄賁、郯、戚以益瑯邪，省昌慮郡。〔一〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-66" id="annotation-66">[66]</a> Wèi shū records the Tenth Moon [206 Nov 19 – Dec 17] Yǐhài Order  stating: “In the governance of the world and leading of the masses, the establishment and appointment of supporters and assistants, the prohibition is in feigning agreement.  The Shī states: ‘Listen and employ my plan, you will have no great regrets.’  This truly is the pursuit of earnest authenticity between lords and servants. I fill a heavy appointment, always fearing to miss the correct. For several years already I have not heard excellent plans. Is it my fault for not being diligent to be open and solicitous? From now afterward, the various assistants and associates,  Managing Internal, Separate Carriage, are to regularly at the beginning of the moon each report the failures, and I will review them.”
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏書載十月乙亥令曰：「夫治世御眾，建立輔弼，誡在面從，詩稱『聽用我謀，庶無大悔』，斯實君臣懇懇之求也。吾充重任，每懼失中，頻年已來，不聞嘉謀，豈吾開延不勤之咎邪？自今以後，諸掾屬治中、別駕，常以月旦各言其失，吾將覽焉。」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
The Three Prefectures Wūhuán took advantage of the chaos of Heaven’s Under, defeating Yōu Province, capturing Hàn people of altogether over a hundred thousand households. Yuán Shào established all their powerful leaders as Chányú and had the children of his household servants act as his own daughters to be their wives. Liáoxī’s Chányú Tàdùn  was exceptionally powerful, generously treated by [Yuán] Shào, and therefore [Yuán] Shàng and his brothers took refuge with him, repeatedly entering the passes to do harm. The Excellency was about to campaign against them, dug a canal from Hūtà to the Gū river, <a href="#annotation-67" id="source-67">[67]</a> naming it Pínglǔ canal.  Also from the Jù river’s mouth <a href="#annotation-68" id="source-68">[68]</a> dug to the Lù river, naming it Quánzhōu canal, to connect to the sea.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
三郡烏丸承天下亂，破幽州，略有漢民合十餘萬戶。袁紹皆立其酋豪為單于，以家人子為己女，妻焉。遼西單于蹋頓尤彊，為紹所厚，故尚兄弟歸之，數入塞為害。公將征之，鑿渠，自呼遝入泒水，〔一〕名平虜渠；又從泃河口〔二〕。鑿入潞河，名泉州渠，以通海。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-67" id="annotation-67">[67]</a> Gū pronounced Gū.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　泒音孤。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-68" id="annotation-68">[68]</a> Jù pronounced Jù.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　泃音句
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Twelfth Year, Spring, Second Moon [207 Mar 17 – Apr 14], the Excellency from Chúnyú returned to Yè. Dīngyǒu [207 Mar 21], Order said: “[From when] I raised Righteous Troops to eliminate brutality and chaos, to now it has been nineteen years, every campaign a certain success. How is it my achievement? It was by the strength of the worthy servicemen officials. Although Heaven’s Under is not yet completely settled, I will with the worthy servicemen officials together settle it. But if I alone monopolize the rewards for the labors, how can I be at ease? Thus urgently determine achievements to enact enfeoffments.” Therefore greatly enfeoffed accomplished ministers of over twenty men, all as Ranked Marquesses, the rest each in order received enfeoffment, reaching to the orphans of those that died in service, lightness or heaviness each on distinct basis. <a href="#annotation-69" id="source-69">[69]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
十二月春二月，公自淳于還鄴。丁酋，令曰：「吾起義兵誅暴亂，於今十九年，所征必克，豈吾功哉？乃賢士大夫之力也。天下雖未悉定，吾當要與賢士大夫共定之；而專饗其勞，吾何以安焉！其促定功行封。」於是大封功臣二十餘人，皆為列侯，其餘各以次受封，及復死事之孤，輕重各有差。〔一〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-69" id="annotation-69">[69]</a> Wèi shū records the Excellency’s Order stating: “In the past when Zhào Shē and Dòu Yīng were Generals,  on receiving bestowals of one thousand gold, in one morning they distributed it, and therefore were able to complete great achievements, forever through the ages spreading reputation. When I read their stories, never once have I not admired their conduct as men. With the various officers and servicemen officials together following in military affairs, I have been fortunate to rely on worthy men not begrudging to share their plans, on crowds of servicemen not being miserly with their strength, and so cut down dangers and pacified chaos, and yet I have obtained great rewards, income from thirty thousand households. In recollection of the meaning of Dòu Yīng distributing gold, now divide the received income with the various officers and assistants and associates and those of the former garrisons of Chén and Cài,  give cultivated land to reward the labors of the multitudes, to not usurp all the great favor. It is appropriate to gather the orphans of those that died in service, and have the income and grain reach them. If the year’s harvest is sufficient for use, income and offerings successfully arriving, then greatly share with everyone to all together enjoy them.”
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏書載公令曰：「昔趙奢、竇嬰之為將也，受賜千金，一朝散之，故能濟成大功，永世流聲。吾讀其文，未嘗不慕其為人也。與諸將士大夫共從戎事，幸賴賢人不愛其謀，群士不遺其力，是夷險平亂，而吾得竊大賞，戶邑三萬。追思竇嬰散金之義，今分所受租與諸將掾屬及故戍于陳、蔡者，庶以疇答眾勞，不擅大惠也。宜差死事之孤，以租穀及之。若年殷用足，租奉畢入，將大與眾人悉共饗之。」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
When about to campaign north against the Three Prefectures Wūhuán, the various officers all said: “Yuán Shàng is only a fleeing caitiff. The Yí and Dí are greedy and without kinship,  so how can they be employed by [Yuán] Shàng? Now to deeply penetrate to campaign against them, Liú Bèi will certainly persuade Liú Biǎo to attack Xǔ. If ten thousand to one there is a disaster, the situation could not be repented.” Only Guō Jiā calculated that [Liú] Biǎo certainly would not appoint [Liú] Bèi, and encouraged the Excellency to go.
Summer, Fifth Moon [207 Jun 13 – Jul 12], reached Wúzhōng. 
Autumn, Seventh Moon [207 Aug 11 – Sep 9], great flood, the roads beside the sea were impassable. Tián Chóu requested to be a local guide, the Excellency followed him.  Led the army to set out Lúlóng pass.  Beyond the passes the roads were cut off and impassable, thus dug through mountains and filled in valleys for over five hundred lǐ, across Báitán, through Pínggāng, treading the Xiānbēi court, east to reach Liǔchéng.  They had not yet arrived by two hundred lǐ, the caitiffs then became aware of them, [Yuán] Shàng and [Yuán] Xī with Tàdùn, Liáoxī’s Chányú Lóubān, Yòuběipíng’s Chányú Néngchéndǐzhī and others commanded several tens of thousands of cavalry to oppose the army.  
Eighth Moon [207 Sep 10 – Oct 8], climbed up Báilángshān,  suddenly with the caitiffs encountering, their multitudes extremely many. The Excellency’s heavy supply wagons were to the rear, those wearing armor few, the Left and Right were all afraid. The Excellency climbed up high, observed the caitiff battle lines were not organized, and thus unleased troops to strike them, sending Zhāng Liáo as the front charge, the caitiff multitudes greatly collapsed, beheaded Tàdùn and his named kings on down,  the Hú and Hàn that surrendered were over two hundred thousand. Liáodōng’s Chányú Sùpúwán  and Liáoxī’s and Běipíng’s various leaders abandoned their tribesmen and with [Yuán] Shàng and [Yuán] Xī fled to Liáodōng, their multitudes still were several thousand cavalry.
Previously, Liáodōng Administrator Gōngsūn Kāng took advantage of the distance to refuse to submit.  When the Excellency defeated the Wūhuán, some advised the Excellency to therefore campaign against him, so [Yuán] Shàng and his brothers could be taken. The Excellency said: “I will have [Gōngsūn] Kāng cut off and send the heads of [Yuán] Shàng and Yuán [Xī], to not bother the troops.”
Ninth Moon [207 Oct 9 – Nov 7], the Excellency led the troops from Liǔchéng to return, <a href="#annotation-70" id="source-70">[70]</a> [Gōngsūn] Kāng then beheaded [Yuán] Shàng and [Yuán] Xī with Sùpúwán and the rest, sending their heads. Of the various officers some asked: “Your Excellency returned and yet [Gōngsūn] Kāng beheaded and sent [Yuán] Shàng and [Yuán] Xī. Why?” The Excellency said: “He already feared [Yuán] Shàng and the rest. If I pressed them then they would join strength, releasing them then they on their own plotted against each other. This was natural.” 
Eleventh Moon [207 Dec 7 – 208 Jan 5], reached the Yì river, Dài prefecture Wūhuán Acting Chányú Pǔfúlú and Shàng prefecture Wūhuán Acting Chányú Nālóu led their named kings to come give congratulations.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
將北征三郡烏丸，諸將皆曰：「袁尚，亡虜耳，夷狄貪而無親，豈能為尚用？今深入征之，劉備必說劉表以襲許。萬一為變，事不可悔。」惟郭嘉策表必不能任備，勸公行。夏五用，至無終。秋七月，大水，傍海道不通，田疇請為鄉導，公從之。引軍出盧龍塞，塞外道絕不通，乃塹山堙谷五百餘里，經白檀，歷平岡，涉鮮卑庭，東指柳城。未至二百里，虜乃知之。尚、熙與蹋頓、遼西單于樓班、右北平單于能臣抵之等將數萬騎逆軍。八月，登白狼山，卒與虜遇，眾甚盛。公車重在後，被甲者少，左右皆懼。公登高，望虜陳不整，乃縱兵擊之，使張遼為先鋒，虜眾大崩，斬蹋頓及名王已下，胡、漢降者二十餘萬口。遼東單于速僕丸及遼西、北平諸豪，棄其種人，與尚、熙奔遼東，眾尚有數千騎。初，遼東太守公孫康恃遠不服。及公破烏丸，或說公遂征之，尚兄弟可禽也。公曰：「吾方使康斬送尚、熙首，不煩兵矣。」九月，公引兵自柳城還，〔一〕康即斬尚、熙及速僕丸等，傳其首。諸將或問：「公還而康斬送尚、熙，何也？」公曰：「彼素畏尚等，吾急之則并力，緩之則自相圖，其勢然也。」十一月至易水，代郡烏丸行單于普富盧、上郡烏丸行單于那樓將其名王來賀。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-70" id="annotation-70">[70]</a> Cáo Mán zhuàn states: At the time there was cold and drought, within two hundred lǐ there was no water supply, the army also was short on food, killed horses of several thousand for provisions, dug into the ground by over thirty zhàng to get water.  When he returned, he asked after those that had previously remonstrated, of the multitudes none knew the reason, and person after person was all afraid. The Excellency generously rewarded them all, saying: “In the previous action, I rode into danger and succeeded by fortune. Though successful, it was by Heaven’s assistance. Therefore it cannot be the norm. The remonstrations of you sirs were plans for thorough security, and therefore you receive rewards. Afterwards do not fear speaking up.”
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　曹瞞傳曰：時寒且旱，二百里無復水，軍又乏食，殺馬數千匹以為糧，鑿地入三十餘丈乃得水。既還，科問前諫者，眾莫知其故，人人皆懼。公皆厚賞之，曰：「孤前行，乘危以徼倖，雖得之，天所佐也，故不可以為常。諸君之諫，萬安之計，是以相賞，後勿難言之。」
:::
:::
:::

## Jiàn'ān 13 - 16 (208 - 211) {.unnumbered}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Thirteenth Year, Spring, Standard Moon [208 Feb 4 – Mar 4], the Excellency returned to Yè, built Xuánwǔ reservoir to train a navy.  <a href="#annotation-71" id="source-71">[71]</a>
Hàn abolished the Three Excellencies offices and installed an Assistant Chancellor and Censorate Grandee.  Summer, Sixth Moon [208 Jul 1 – Jul 30], appointed the Excellency as Assistant Chancellor. <a href="#annotation-72" id="source-72">[72]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
十三年春正月，公還鄴，作玄武池以肄舟師。〔一〕漢罷三公官，置丞相、御史大夫。夏六月，以公為丞相。〔二〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-71" id="annotation-71">[71]</a> Yì (to train) is pronounced Yǐ and Sì together. Sāncāng states: Yì (to train) means to practice.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　肄，以四反。三蒼曰：「肄，習也。」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-72" id="annotation-72">[72]</a> Xiàn-dì Qǐjū zhù states: Sent Minister of Ceremonies Xú Qiú to directly confer the Seal and Ribbon. Censorate Grandee did not manage the [Censorate] Central Deputy, installed a Chief Scribe of one man. 

Xiānxián Xíngzhuàng states: [Xú] Qiú appellation Mèngyù was a Guǎnglíng man.  As a youth, in conduct he was pure and honest, stood in Court with upright expression. He successively served in Rènchéng, Rǔnán, Dōnghǎi three prefectures, wherever he was cultivation spread. Summoned and about to return, he was seized by Yuán Shù. [Yuán] Shù usurped titles and wished to confer him with rank above the Excellencies, [Xú] Qiú to the end would not submit. After [Yuán] Shù died, [Xú] Qiú obtained [Yuán] Shù’s Ruler’s Seal and delivered it to the Hàn Court, appointed Minister of the Guard  and Minister of Ceremonies. When the Excellency became Assistant Chancellor he deferred the rank to [Xú] Qiú.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　獻帝起居注曰：使太常徐璆即授印綬。御史大夫不領中丞，置長史一人。先賢行狀曰：璆字（孟平）〔孟玉〕，廣陵人。少履清爽，立朝正色。歷任城、汝南、東海三郡，所在化行。被徵當還，為袁術所劫。術僭號，欲授以上公之位，璆終不為屈。術死後，璆得術璽，致之漢朝，拜衛尉太常；公為丞相，以位讓璆焉。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Autumn, Seventh Moon [208 Jul 31 – Aug 28], the Excellency campaigned south against Liú Biǎo.
Eighth Moon [208 Aug 29 – Sep 27], [Liú] Biǎo died, his son [Liú] Cóng succeeded, garrisoned Xiāngyáng. Liú Bèi garrisoned Fán. 
Ninth Moon [208 Sep 28 – Oct 26], the Excellency arrived at Xīnyě, [Liú] Cóng therefore surrendered, [Liú] Bèi fled to Xiàkǒu.  The Excellency advanced the army to Jiānglíng,  sent down orders to Jīng Province’s officials and civilians to with them restart anew. Thus discussed the achievement of Jīng Province submitting, those made Marquesses were fifteen men, appointed Liú Biǎo’s chief officer Wén Pìn as Jiāngxià Administrator, sent to command his original troops, invited and employed Jīng Province’s famed servicemen Hán Sōng, Dèng Yì, and others. <a href="#annotation-73" id="source-73">[73]</a> Yì Province Governor Liú Zhāng  first received summons for conscription and sent troops to provide for the army.
Twelfth Moon [208 Dec 25 – 209 Jan 23], Sūn Quán  for [Liú] Bèi attacked Héféi. The Excellency from Jiānglíng campaigned against [Liú] Bèi, reached Bāqiū, sent Zhāng Xǐ to rescue Héféi.  [Sūn] Quán heard that [Zhāng] Xǐ had arrived and thus fled. The Excellency reached Chìbì,  engaged [Liú] Bèi in battle, not successful. Then there was a great epidemic, of the officials and servicemen many died, thus led the army to return. [Liú] Bèi therefore possessed Jīng Province’s various prefectures south of the Jiāng. <a href="#annotation-74" id="source-74">[74]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
秋七月，公南征劉表。八月，表卒，其子琮代，屯襄陽，劉備屯樊。九月，公到新野，琮遂降，備走夏口。公進軍江陵，下令荊州吏民，與之更始。乃論荊州服從之功，侯者十五人，以劉表大將文聘為江夏太守，使統本兵，引用荊州名士韓嵩、鄧義等。〔一〕益州牧劉璋始受徵役，遣兵給軍。十二月，孫權為備攻合肥。公自江陵征備，至巴丘，遣張憙救合肥。權聞憙至，乃走。公至赤壁，與備戰，不利。於是大疫，吏士多死者，乃引軍還。備遂有荊州、江南諸郡。〔二〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-73" id="annotation-73">[73]</a> Wèi Héng’s Sìtǐ Shūshì xù  states: Shànggǔ’s Wáng Cìzhòng excelled in clerical script, first making the regular methods.  Reaching to Emperor Líng, he enjoyed calligraphy, the world had many with ability [in calligraphy], but Shī Yíguān was the greatest, extremely boastful of his ability, every time he wrote, at once he pared and burned his writing strips.  Liáng Hú  thus made additional writing boards and gave him alcohol to drink, watched for when he was intoxicated and stole the writing strips. [Liáng] Hú in the end by studying calligraphy reached Selections Department Secretariat Writer.  At the time the Excellency [Cáo Cāo] wished to be Luòyáng Magistrate, but [Liáng] Hú appointed him as North Division Commandant. [Liáng] Hú later took refuge with Liú Biǎo. When Jīng Province was pacified, the Excellency sought after [Liáng] Hú. [Liáng] Hú was afraid, bound himself when going to the gates,  and was appointed Army Temporary Major, having him in the Confidential Writers,  to devote himself to diligence in calligraphy. The Excellency often hung his writings in the tents, even nailing them to the walls to appreciate it, saying it surpassed [Shī] Yíguān. [Liáng] Hú appellation Mènghuáng was an Āndìng man.  The Wèi Palace Halls’ signs were all [Liáng] Hú’s calligraphy.

Huángfǔ Mì’s Yìshì zhuàn  states: Rǔnán’s Wáng Jùn appellation Zǐwén  as a youth was noted by Fàn Pāng and Xǔ Zhāng, and friendly with Nányáng’s Cén Zhǐ.  When the Excellency [Cáo Cāo] was in plain clothes, he specially favored [Wáng] Jùn. [Wáng] Jùn also praised the Excellency as having the skills to govern the world. When Yuán Shào and his younger brother [Yuán] Shù were in mourning for their mother,  returning for the burial in Rǔnán, [Wáng] Jùn and the Excellency attended it. Those gathered were thirty thousand people. The Excellency outside secretly spoke with [Wáng] Jùn saying: “Heaven’s Under will be in chaos, the ones to take the lead in the chaos will certainly be these two men. I wish to rescue Heaven’s Under and save the lives of the Hundred Surnames. If these two men are not first executed, chaos will now be created.” [Wáng] Jùn said: “If it is as you say, the one to rescue Heaven’s Under, if it is not you who else is there?” They faced one another and laughed. [Wáng] Jùn as a man was outside calm but inside brilliant, did not accept the appointments of the provinces, prefectures, or Three Offices. Summoned with a Government Carriage, he did not arrive, but left the land and resided in Wǔlíng,  those that submitted to [Wáng] Jùn were over a hundred families. When the Emperor set the capital at Xǔ, he was again summoned as a Secretariat Writer, again he did not accept. Liú Biǎo observed [Yuán] Shào was powerful and secretly communicated with [Yuán] Shào. [Wáng] Jùn said to [Liú] Biǎo saying: “Excellency Cáo is a hero of Heaven’s Under, certainly able to raise the way of the hegemons and continue the achievements of Huán and Wén.  Now to then abandon the near and seek the far,  if one morning there is an emergency, and you distantly look out for rescue from north of the deserts, is that not yet a problem?” [Liú] Biǎo did not listen. [Wáng] Jùn at sixty-four years had his life end at Wǔlíng. The Excellency heard and grieved. When Jīng Province was pacified, he personally overlooked the Jiāng to welcome the body, moved its burial to Jiānglíng, and memorialized him as a Former Worthy.

〔一〕　衛恆四體書勢序曰：上谷王次仲善隸書，始為楷法。至靈帝好書，世多能者。而師宜官為最，甚矜其能，每書，輒削焚其札。梁鵠乃益為版而飲之酒，候其醉而竊其札，鵠卒以攻書至選部尚書。於是公欲為洛陽令，鵠以為北部尉。鵠後依劉表。及荊州平，公募求鵠，鵠懼，自縛詣門，署軍假司馬，使在祕書，以（勤）〔勒〕書自效。公嘗懸著帳中，及以釘壁玩之，謂勝宜官。鵠字孟黃，安定人。魏宮殿題署，皆鵠書也。皇甫謐逸士傳曰：汝南王雋，字子文，少為范滂、許章所識，與南陽岑晊善。公之為布衣，特愛雋；雋亦稱公有治世之具。及袁紹與弟術喪母，歸葬汝南，雋與公會之，會者三萬人。公於外密語雋曰：「天下將亂，為亂魁者必此二人也。欲濟天下，為百姓請命，不先誅此二子，亂今作矣。」雋曰：「如卿之言，濟天下者，舍卿復誰？」相對而笑。雋為人外靜而內明，不應州郡三府之命。公車徵，不到，避地居武陵，歸雋者一百餘家。帝之都許，復徵為尚書，又不就。劉表見紹彊，陰與紹通，雋謂表曰：「曹公，天下之雄也，必能興霸道，繼桓、文之功者也。今乃釋近而就遠，如有一朝之急，遙望漠北之救，不亦難乎！」表不從。雋年六十四，以壽終于武陵，公聞而哀傷。及平荊州，自臨江迎喪，改葬于江陵，表為先賢也。

<a href="#source-74" id="annotation-74">[74]</a> Shānyáng-gōng Zàijì  states: The Excellency’s ships were burned by [Liú] Bèi. He led the army by Huáróng road  on foot to return, encountered mud, the roads impassable, the weather also was greatly windy. Sent all the weak soldiers to carry grass on their back to fill it in, the cavalry thus was able to pass. The weak soldiers were trampled by men and horses, trapped in the mud, the dead extremely many. When the army was able to escape, the Excellency was greatly pleased. The various officers asked him. The Excellency said: “Liú Bèi is my peer,  but his plans are a little late. If he had earlier started a fire, we would not have survived.” [Liú] Bèi soon indeed set a fire but it was too late.

Sūn Shèng’s Yìtóng Píng  states: According to Wú zhì, Liú Bèi first defeated the Excellency’s army and only afterward [Sūn] Quán attacked Héféi, but this record says [Sūn] Quán first attacked Héféi and afterward there was the situation of Chìbì. The two disagree, and Wú zhì is the correct one.

〔二〕　山陽公載記曰：公船艦為備所燒，引軍從華容道步歸，遇泥濘，道不通，天又大風，悉使羸兵負草填之，騎乃得過。羸兵為人馬所蹈藉，陷泥中，死者甚眾。軍既得出，公大喜，諸將問之，公曰：「劉備，吾儔也。但得計少晚；向使早放火，吾徒無類矣。」備尋亦放火而無所及。孫盛異同評曰：按吳志，劉備先破公軍，然後權攻合肥，而此記云權先攻合肥，後有赤壁之事。二者不同，吳志為是。

Fourteenth Year, Spring, Third Moon [209 Apr 22 – May 21], the army reached Qiáo, built light ships, drilled the navy.
Autumn, Seventh Moon [209 Aug 19 – Sep 16], from the Guō entered the Huái, exiting to the Féi river, the army stationed Héféi.  Xīnwèi [209 Oct 10], Order said: “From since recently onward, the army has repeatedly been on campaign, sometimes encountered disease, officials and soldiers dying and unable to return home, wives and households mourn their absence, the Hundred Surnames wander in exile; how can one of benevolence be happy about this? It is that it cannot but be so. Thus order that for the families of the dead that are without property and unable to maintain themselves, county offices are not to cut off access to the granaries, and chief clerks must care for and give relief, to accord with my intentions.” Installed in Yáng Province’s prefectures and counties Chief Clerks, opened Quèbēi  Garrison-Farms.
Twelfth Moon [210 Jan 13 – Feb 11], the army returned to Qiáo.
