Sixteenth Year, Spring, Standard Moon [211 Feb 1 – Mar 2], <a href="#annotation-76" id="source-76">[76]</a> Heaven’s Son mandated the Excellency’s Heir Presumptive [Cáo] Pī be Five Office Central Cadet General, installing office associates, to be the Assistant Chancellor’s aide.  Tàiyuán’s Shāng Yào and others in Dàlíng rebelled, sent Xiàhóu Yuān and Xú Huǎng to besiege, defeated them. 
Zhāng Lǔ occupied Hànzhōng. Third Moon [211 Apr 1 – Apr 30], sent Zhōng Yáo to suppress him.  The Excellency sent [Xiàhóu] Yuān and others to set out Hédōng to join with [Zhōng] Yáo.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
十六年春正月，〔一〕天子命公世子丕為五官中郎將，置官屬，為丞相副。太原商曜等以大陵叛，遣夏侯淵、徐晃圍破之。張魯據漢中，三月，遣鍾繇討之。公使淵等出河東與繇會。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-76" id="annotation-76">[76]</a> Wèi shū states: Gēngchén [211 Feb 11], Heaven’s Son replied, reduced the households by five thousand, divided the ceded three counties and fifteen thousand to enfeoff three sons, [Cáo] Zhí as Marquess of Píngyuán, [Cáo] Jù as Marquess of Fànyáng, [Cáo] Bào as Marquess of Ráoyáng, income of each five thousand households.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏書曰：庚辰，天子報：減戶五千，分所讓三縣萬五千封三子，植為平原侯，據為范陽侯，豹為饒陽侯，食邑各五千戶。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
At the time, Guānzhōng’s various officers suspected that [Zhōng] Yáo wished to attack them, Mǎ Chāo therefore with Hán Suì, Yáng Qiū, Lǐ Kān, Chéng Yí, and others rebelled.  Sent Cáo Rén to suppress them. [Mǎ] Chāo and the rest garrisoned Tóng Pass.  The Excellency ordered the various officers: “West of the passes the troops are elite and fierce. Fortify ramparts and do not engage in battle.”
Autumn, Seventh Moon [Jul 28 – Aug 26], the Excellency campaigned west, <a href="#annotation-77" id="source-77">[77]</a> the army with [Mǎ] Chāo and the rest on each side of the pass. The Excellency pressed and held them, secretly sent Xú Huǎng and Zhū Líng and others in the night to cross Púbǎn ford,  occupying the Hé’s west and making camp. The Excellency from Tóng Pass crossed north, had not yet completely crossed, when [Mǎ] Chāo reached the ships and pressed to battle. Colonel Dīng Fěi  therefore released the oxen and horses to lure the rebels, the rebels chaotically seized the oxen and horses, and the Excellency thus was able to cross. <a href="#annotation-78" id="source-78">[78]</a> Following the Hé he made a covered passage  and went south. The rebels retreated, resisting at the mouth of the Wèi. The Excellency thus deployed many decoy troops, secretly with boats transported troops into the Wèi, made pontoon bridges, in the night divided troops to link camps at the Wèi’s south. The rebels in the night attacked the camp, ambush troops struck and defeated them. [Mǎ] Chāo and the rest garrisoned the Wèi’s south, sent letters asking to cede the west of the Hé to make peace. The Excellency did not accept.
Ninth Moon [211 Oct 25 – Nov 22], advanced the army to cross the Wèi. <a href="#annotation-79" id="source-79">[79]</a> [Mǎ] Chāo and the rest repeatedly challenged battle. Again did not accept. They firmly requested to cede territory and asked to send hostage sons. The Excellency employed Jiǎ Xǔ’s plan and falsely agreed to it. Hán Suì requested to meet with the Excellency. The Excellency and [Hán] Suì’s father were Filial-Incorruptible [candidates] of the same year, and also, he and [Hán] Suì were of the same generation, and so they therefore rode horses together conversing for some time, not discussing army affairs, only speaking of their past experiences in the capital, patting hands and laughing. When they separated, [Mǎ] Chāo and the rest asked [Hán] Suì: “What did the Excellency say?” [Hán] Suì said: “Nothing worth mentioning.” [Mǎ] Chāo and the rest suspected him. <a href="#annotation-80" id="source-80">[80]</a> Another day, the Excellency also sent [Hán] Suì a letter, with many edits, as if [Hán] Suì had changed it. [Mǎ] Chāo and the rest became more suspicious of [Hán] Suì. The Excellency then with them set a day to meet in battle, first sending light troops to harass them, battling for a long while, then unleashed the Tiger Cavalry  in pincer strike, greatly defeated them, beheaded Chéng Yí and Lǐ Kān and others. [Hán] Suì and [Mǎ] Chāo fled to Liáng Province, Yáng Qiū fled to Āndìng. Guānzhōng was pacified.
Of the various officers some asked the Excellency: “Previously, the rebels defended Tóng Pass, the road north of the Wèi was empty, we did not from Hédōng strike to Píngyì  but instead defended Tóng Pass for several days and then afterward crossed north. Why?” The Excellency said: “When the rebels defended Tóng Pass, if I entered Hédōng, the rebels would certainly withdraw to defend the various fords, and then we could not cross west of the Hé. I therefore massed troops facing Tóng Pass. The rebels all gathered south to defend, the west of the Hé was without preparations, and therefore two officers were able to seize the west of the Hé. Afterward when I led the army to cross north, that the rebels were not able contest the west of the Hé with me, was because there was the army of the two officers. Connecting carts and setting fences, making a covered passageway and going south, <a href="#annotation-81" id="source-81">[81]</a> was to be unconquerable, but also to appear weak. Crossing the Wèi and building fortifications, not going out when the caitiffs arrived, was to make them overconfident. Therefore the rebels did not make camp fortifications and offered to cede territory. I deferentially said I would agree to this, in keeping with their wishes, to cause them to feel secure and not make preparations, and therefore nurtured the strength of the soldiers, in one morning struck them, what is called ‘sudden thunder with no time to cover the ears.’  The transformations of warfare assuredly are not a single path.”
Previously, when each division of rebels arrived, the Excellency at once had a pleased expression. After defeating the rebels, the various officers asked the reason. The Excellency answered saying: “Guānzhōng is broad and remote. If the rebels each held to difficult terrain, in campaigning against them, without [spending] one to two years they could not be settled. Now they all came gathered, though their multitudes were many, none obeyed one another, the army had no overall leader. With one move they could be destroyed, the achievement would be easy, and I was therefore pleased.”
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
是時關中諸將疑繇欲自襲，馬超遂與韓遂、楊秋、李堪、成宜等叛。遣曹仁討之。超等屯潼關，公敕諸將：「關西兵精悍，堅壁勿與戰。」秋七月，公西征，〔一〕與超等夾關而軍。公急持之，而潛遣徐晃、朱靈等夜渡蒲阪津，據河西為營。公自潼關北渡，未濟，超赴船急戰。校尉丁斐因放牛馬以餌賊，賊亂取牛馬，公乃得渡，〔二〕循河為甬道而南。賊退，拒渭口，公乃多設疑兵，潛以舟載兵入渭，為浮橋，夜，分兵結營于渭南。賊夜攻營，伏兵擊破之。超等屯渭南，遣信求割河以西請和，公不許。九月，進軍渡渭。〔三〕超等數挑戰，又不許；固請割地，求送任子，公用賈詡計，偽許之。韓遂請與公相見，公與遂父同歲孝廉，又與遂同時儕輩，於是交馬語移時，不及軍事，但說京都舊故，拊手歡笑。既罷，超等問遂：「公何言？」遂曰：「無所言也。」超等疑之。〔四〕他日，公又與遂書，多所點竄，如遂改定者；超等愈疑遂。公乃與克日會戰，先以輕兵挑之，戰良久，乃縱虎騎夾擊，大破之，斬成宜、李堪等。遂、超等走涼州，楊秋奔安定，關中平。諸將或問公曰：「初，賊守潼關，渭北道缺，不從河東擊馮翊而反守潼關，引日而後北渡，何也？」公曰：「賊守潼關，若吾入河東，賊必引守諸津，則西河未可渡，吾故盛兵向潼關；賊悉眾南守，西河之備虛，故二將得擅取西河；然後引軍北渡，賊不能與吾爭西河者，以有二將之軍也。連車樹柵，為甬道而南，〔五〕既為不可勝，且以示弱。渡渭為堅壘，虜至不出，所以驕之也；故賊不為營壘而求割地。吾順言許之，所以從其意，使自安而不為備，因畜士卒之力，一旦擊之，所謂疾雷不及掩耳，兵之變化，固非一道也。」始，賊每一部到，公輒有喜色。賊破之後，諸將問其故。公答曰：「關中長遠，若賊各依險阻，征之，不一二年不可定也。今皆來集，其眾雖多，莫相歸服，軍無適主，一舉可滅，為功差易，吾是以喜。」
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-77" id="annotation-77">[77]</a> Wèi shū states: Of the commentators many said: “The troops west of the passes are strong, trained with long spears. If it is not chosen elites at the front, then they cannot be faced.” The Excellency said to the various officers: “Battle is decided by us, not by the rebels. Though the rebels are trained with long spears, they will not be allowed to use them. You sirs merely wait and see.”
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏書曰：議者多言「關西兵彊，習長矛，非精選前鋒，則不可以當也」。公謂諸將曰：「戰在我，非在賊也。賊雖習長矛，將使不得以刺，諸君但觀之耳。」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-78" id="annotation-78">[78]</a> Cáo Mán zhuàn states: The Excellency was about to cross the Hé, the front squadrons had just crossed when [Mǎ] Chāo and the rest suddenly arrived. The Excellency yet sat on a Hú chair and did not rise.  Zhāng Hé and the rest saw the situation was desperate, and together led the Excellency onto a boat. The Hé’s waters were rapid, during the crossing flowing four to five lǐ.  [Mǎ] Chāo and the rest’s cavalry pursued and shot at it, arrows falling like rain. The various officers saw that the army was defeated, did not know where the Excellency was, and all were anxious and afraid. Reaching to seeing him, then they were sorrowful and happy, some shedding tears. The Excellency greatly laughed and said: “Today I was almost trapped by the little rebel!”
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　曹瞞傳曰：公將過河，前隊適渡，超等奄至，公猶坐胡床不起。張郃等見事急，共引公入船。河水急，比渡，流四五里，超等騎追射之，矢下如雨。諸將見軍敗，不知公所在，皆惶懼，至見，乃悲喜，或流涕。公大笑曰：「今日幾為小賊所困乎！」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-79" id="annotation-79">[79]</a> Cáo Mán zhuàn states: At the time whenever the Excellency crossed the Wèi, at once they were charged by [Mǎ] Chāo’s cavalry, the camp could not be established. The ground also was very sandy, and could not be built into walls. Lóu Zǐbó advised the Excellency saying: “Now the weather is cold, we can raise sand into walls and with water cement it, and in one night it can be completed.” The Excellency followed this, and so made many silk sacks to transport water, in the night crossed over troops to build the wall, and by dawn the city wall was established. Because of this the Excellency’s army was able to completely cross the Wèi.

Some suspect this time was the Ninth Moon, the water not yet able to freeze. Your Servant Sōngzhī cites Wèi shū: “The Excellency’s Army in the Eighth Moon reached Tóng Pass, in the Intercalary Moon crossed the Hé north,” then that year had an Intercalary Eighth Moon, and by this then the weather could have been very cold.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔三〕　曹瞞傳曰：時公軍每渡渭，輒為超騎所衝突，營不得立，地又多沙，不可築壘。婁子伯說公曰：「今天寒，可起沙為城，以水灌之，可一夜而成。」公從之，乃多作縑囊以運水，夜渡兵作城，比明，城立，由是公軍盡得渡渭。或疑于時九月，水未應凍。臣松之按魏書：公軍八月至潼關，閏月北渡河，則其年閏八月也，至此容可大寒邪！
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-80" id="annotation-80">[80]</a> Wèi shū states: The Excellency the day after next again with [Hán] Suì and the rest met to talk. The various officers said: “When Your Excellency meets with the caitiffs for talks, it is not appropriate to be reckless. We can use wooden sawhorses as a defense and restraint.”  The Excellency agreed to this. When the rebel officers met with the Excellency, they all paid respects from atop their horses. The Qín  and Hú that were watching beginning to end piled together. The Excellency laughed and said to the rebels: “You wish to see Excellency Cáo? He is like any other man. He does not have four eyes or two mouths, just more intelligence!” The Hú front to back all greatly stared. Also lined up Iron Cavalry of five thousand in ten rows, shining like the sun,  the rebels were increasingly shaken and afraid.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔四〕　魏書曰：公後日復與遂等會語，諸將曰：「公與虜交語，不宜輕脫，可為木行馬以為防遏。」公然之。賊將見公，悉于馬上拜，秦、胡觀者，前後重沓，公笑謂賊曰：「汝欲觀曹公邪？亦猶人也，非有四目兩口，但多智耳！」胡前後大觀。又列鐵騎五千為十重陳，精光耀日，賊益震懼。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-81" id="annotation-81">[81]</a> Your Servant Sōngzhī notes: Hàn Gāozǔ Second Year [205 BC], with Chǔ battled between Xíngyáng’s Jīng and Suǒ,  built covered passageways along the Hé to obtain Áo Granary’s grain. Yìng Shào states: “Fearing the enemy would capture the supply wagons, therefore built walls like a street alley.” Now Wèi Wǔ [Cáo Cāo] did not build walls, only linked carriages with wooden fences to defend both sides.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔五〕　臣松之案：漢高祖二年，與楚戰滎陽京、索之間，築甬道屬河以取敖倉粟。應劭曰：「恐敵鈔輜重，故築垣牆如街巷也。」今魏武不築垣牆，但連車樹柵以扞兩面。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Winter, Tenth Moon [211 Nov 23 – Dec 22], the army from Cháng’ān campaigned north against Yáng Qiū, besieging Āndìng. [Yáng] Qiū surrendered, restored his noble rank and position, having him remain to succor the people. <a href="#annotation-82" id="source-82">[82]</a>
Twelfth Moon [212 Jan 21 – Feb 19], from Āndìng returned, leaving Xiàhóu Yuān to garrison Cháng’ān.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
冬十月，軍自長安北征楊秋，圍安定。秋降，復其爵位，使留撫其民人。〔一〕十二月，自安定還，留夏侯淵屯長安。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-82" id="annotation-82">[82]</a> Wèi lüè states: Yáng Qiū during Huángchū [220 – 226] was promoted to Suppressing Bandits General, ranked Specially Advanced, enfeoffed Marquess of Línjīng, died of old age.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　　魏略曰：楊秋，黃初中遷討寇將軍，位特進，封臨涇侯，以壽終。
:::
:::
:::

## Jiàn'ān 17 - 18 (212 - 213) {.unnumbered}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Seventeenth Year, Spring, Standard Moon [212 Feb 20 – Mar 20], the Excellency returned to Yè. Heaven’s Son mandated that the Excellency in paying respects was not to use personal name, to enter Court without hastening step, to wear sword and shoes when ascending Palace Halls, following the precedent of Xiāo Hé.  Mǎ Chāo’s remnant multitudes Liáng Xīng and others garrisoned Lántián,  sent Xiàhóu Yuān to strike, pacified them. Divided out Hénèi’s Dàngyīn, Zhāogē, Línlǜ; Dōng Prefecture’s Wèiguó, Dùnqiū, Dōngwǔyáng, Fā’gān; Jùlù’s Yíngtáo, Qǔzhōu, Nánhé, Guǎngpíng, Rèn; Zhào’s Xiāngguó, Hándān, Yìyáng, to add to Wèi Prefecture.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
十七年春正月，公還鄴。天子命公贊拜不名，入朝不趨，劍履上殿，如蕭何故事。馬超餘眾梁興等屯藍田，使夏侯淵擊平之。割河內之蕩陰、朝歌、林慮，東郡之衛國、頓丘、東武陽、發干，鉅鹿之廮陶、曲周、南和，廣平之任城，趙之襄國、邯鄲、易陽以益魏郡。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Winter, Tenth Moon [212 Nov 12 – Dec 10], the Excellency campaigned against Sūn Quán.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
冬十月，公征孫權。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Eighteenth Year, Spring, Standard Moon [213 Feb 8 – Mar 9], advanced the army to Rúxūkǒu, attacked and destroyed [Sūn] Quán’s camps west of the Jiāng, captured [Sūn] Quán’s Overall Supervisor Gōngsūn Yáng,  then led the army to return. Written Edict to merge the Fourteen Provinces to again form Nine Provinces.  
Summer, Fourth Moon [213 May 8 – Jun 6], reached Yè.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
十八年春正月，進軍濡須口，攻破權江西營，獲權都督公孫陽，乃引軍還。詔書并十四州，復為九州。夏四月，至鄴。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Fifth Moon Bǐngshēn [213 Jun 16], Heaven’s Son sent Censorate Grandee Chī Lǜ Holding Stave with conferment mandate on the Excellency to become Duke of Wèi, <a href="#annotation-83" id="source-83">[83]</a> stating:
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
五月丙申，天子使御史大夫郗慮持節策命公為魏公〔一〕曰：
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
We,  being not virtuous, from youth encountered suffering and viciousness, driven into western lands, moving through Táng and Wèi. At that time, [I was] like superfluous tassel, <a href="#annotation-84" id="source-84">[84]</a> the Ancestral Temple lacked sacrifices, the State Altars without a place. Crowds of the vicious watched greedily, dividing apart the various Xià,  the peoples of all the lands, We could not catch, and so the Mandate of our Gāozǔ was about to collapse to the ground. We from morning’s rise to restless sleep  were shaken and mournful in despairing heart, saying: “Oh grandfather oh father, [of your] legs and arms  and former rectifiers, <a href="#annotation-85" id="source-85">[85]</a> who is able to give relief to Our person?” Thus it stirred Heaven’s mercy, bringing forth the Assistant Chancellor [Cáo Cāo], to protect and nurture our Imperial House, vast relief from the hardships and troubles, We truly depend on this. Now about to confer on you the canonical honors, thus vigilantly hear Our command:
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
朕以不德，少遭愍凶，越在西土，遷於唐、衛。當此之時，若綴旒然，〔二〕宗廟乏祀，社稷無位；群凶覬覦，分裂諸夏，率土之民，朕無獲焉，即我高祖之命將墜於地。朕用夙興假寐，震悼於厥心，曰「惟祖惟父，股肱先正，〔三〕其孰能恤朕躬」？乃誘天衷，誕育丞相，保乂我皇家，弘濟於艱難，朕實賴之。今將授君典禮，其敬聽朕命。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
In the past Dǒng Zhuó first created the state’s troubles, the crowds of lords left their seats to plan for the Ruling House, <a href="#annotation-86" id="source-86">[86]</a> you then gathered forces and advanced, first to begin military actions, this was your loyalty to our Court.
Later when the Huángjīn rebelled against natural order, invading our three provinces, reaching to the common people, you again cut them down to give peace to the eastern Xià,  this also was your achievement.
Hán Xiān and Yáng Fèng seized control over power and command, you then came to suppress, defeated and expelled their troubles, and therefore moved the capital to Xǔ, built our capital territory, established offices and restored sacrifices, not losing the old ways, Heaven and Earth and spirits thereupon obtained relief, this also was your achievement.
Yuán Shù usurped and rebelled, unrestrained in Huáinán, fearing and dreading your ability and use of grand and profound strategies, in the Qíyáng campaign,  Qiáo Ruí gave up his head, your power and prestige strode the south, [Yuán] Shù thus fell and collapsed, this also was your achievement.
Turning spears on eastern campaign, Lǚ Bù at once was killed, riding carriage about to return, Zhāng Yáng perished, Suī Gù was submitted to execution, Zhāng Xiù bowed in submission, this also was your achievement.
Yuán Shào opposed and disordered the natural order, plotting to endanger the State Altars, relying on his multitudes, raised troops to oppress the interior. At that time, the Ruler’s Brigades  were few and weak, Heaven’s Under turned cold in heart, none having the will to resist. You held to great integrity, vitality surpassing the white sun, exerting your martial fury, conveying your divine strategies, delivering finality at Guāndù, greatly annihilated the villains, <a href="#annotation-87" id="source-87">[87]</a> allowing our country to be rescued from danger and collapse, this also was your achievement.
Leading the brigades across the vast Hé, opening and settling four provinces,  Yuán Tán and Gāo Gàn both lost their heads, the sea pirates fled and rushed away, the Hēishān submitted to course, this also was your achievement.
Wūhuán of three tribes raised chaos for two generations, Yuán Shàng took advantage of this, terrorizing and occupying the north of the passes. Bundling horses and hanging carts,  in one campaign then destroyed, this also was your achievement.
Liú Biǎo was treacherous and unrestrained, not providing tribute or service, the Ruler’s Brigades started on the road, the powerful winds ahead spreading, a hundred cities and eight prefectures [of Jīng Province] joined arms and bent knees, this also was your achievement.
Mǎ Chāo and Chéng Yí alike in evil supported one another, on the riverbanks occupied the Hé and Tóng, seeking to indulge their desires. Exterminated them at the Wèi’s south, presented kill count  in the tens of thousands, therefore settling the frontier borders, succoring and harmonizing the Róng and Dí, this also was your achievement.
Xiānbēi and Dīnglíng with relay translators arrived, Bìyú and Báiwū requested to submit and offered tribute, this also was your achievement. 
You have the achievement of settling Heaven’s Under, and add to it with brilliant virtue, spreading order Within the Seas, promoting good social customs, broadly applying diligent teachings, careful and cautious in punishments, officials without oppressive governance, civilians without evil thoughts. Reverently honoring the Emperor’s clan, restoring the lineages of cut off successions, old virtues and former achievements, none were not all organized. Though Yī Yǐn matched the August Heavens and Zhōu-gōng shined the Four Seas, they do not compare.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
昔者董卓初興國難，群后釋位以謀王室，〔四〕君則攝進，首啟戎行，此君之忠於本朝也。後及黃巾反易天常，侵我三州，延及平民，君又翦之以寧東夏，此又君之功也。韓暹、楊奉專用威命，君則致討，克黜其難，遂遷許都，造我京畿，設官兆祀，不失舊物，天地鬼神於是獲乂，此又君之功也。袁術僭逆，肆於淮南，懾憚君靈，用丕顯謀，蘄陽之役，橋蕤授首，稜威南邁，術以隕潰，此又君之功也。迴戈東征，呂布就戮，乘轅將返，張楊殂斃，眭固伏罪，張繡稽服，此又君之功也。袁紹逆亂天常，謀危社稷，憑恃其眾，稱兵內侮，當此之時，王師寡弱，天下寒心，莫有固志，君執大節，精貫白日，奮其武怒，運其神策，致屆官渡，大殲醜類，〔五〕俾我國家拯于危墜，此又君之功也。濟師洪河，拓定四州，袁譚、高幹，咸梟其首，海盜奔迸，黑山順軌，此又君之功也。烏丸三種，崇亂二世，袁尚因之，逼據塞北，束馬縣車，一征而滅，此又君之功也。劉表背誕，不供貢職，王師首路，威風先逝，百城八郡，交臂屈膝，此又君之功也。馬超、成宜，同惡相濟，濱據河、潼，求逞所欲，殄之渭南，獻馘萬計，遂定邊境，撫和戎狄，此又君之功也。鮮卑、丁零，重譯而至，（單于）〔箄于〕、白屋，請吏率職，此又君之功也。君有定天下之功，重之以明德，班敘海內，宣美風俗，旁施勤教，恤慎刑獄，吏無苛政，民無懷慝；敦崇帝族，表繼絕世，舊德前功，罔不咸秩；雖伊尹格于皇天，周公光于四海，方之蔑如也。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
We have heard that the Former Kings all established the enlightened and virtuous, granted them with land, shared with them people, honored with exalted regalia, equipped with ritual objects, in order to be vassal screen defenses for the Ruling House, Left and Right through the generations. Thus during Zhōu Chéng, Guǎn and Cài were not peaceful,  in remembrance of the achievement of punishing the troubles, thus sent Shào Kāng-gōng to bestow on Qí Tài-gōng a range east reaching to the sea, west reaching to the Hé, south reaching to Mùlíng, north reaching to Wúdì,  Five Lords Nine Governors, true authority to campaign against them,  for generations blessed as Grand Preceptors, as the border to the eastern sea.  Reaching to King Xiāng, also there was the Chǔ people not providing their obligations to the King, and also the command on Jìn Wén to ascend as hegemon over the lords, bestowed with Two Chariots, Tiger Elite, Ax and Battle-Ax, libation liquor, bows and arrows, greatly expanding to Nányáng, for generations being alliance leader.  The reason the Zhōu House was not destroyed was because it had those two states [Qí and Jìn] to depend upon. Now you possess grand and illustrious virtue, clearly protected Our person, served and answered Heaven’s Mandate, guided and raised vast exploits, thus calming the Nine Regions, none are not led as followers, <a href="#annotation-88" id="source-88">[88]</a> achievements higher than Yī [Yǐn] and Zhōu [gōng], but your rewards are inferior to Qí and Jìn, and We are extremely ashamed of this. We are a lesser person entrusted to be above the millions of people, forever think of their hardships, like treading an abyss of ice; if not for you as the way to cross, We would not be able to bear it.  Now use Jì Province’s Hédōng, Hénèi, Wèi prefecture, Zhào state, Zhōngshān, Chángshān, Jùlù, Ānpíng, Gānlíng, Píngyuán, altogether ten prefectures, to enfeoff you as Duke of Wèi. Bestow on you dark soil, wrapped in white reeds, thus consult your turtle shells, to establish Mound Altars.  In the past during the Zhōu House, Bì-gōng and Máo-gōng entered as minister assistants, Zhōu [gōng] and Shào [gōng] as Preceptor and Protector went out as Two Governors.  Appointments outside and inside, you are truly appropriate for, thus remain as Assistant Chancellor and designate Jì Province Governor as before. Also apply on you the Nine Bestowments,  thus respectfully listen to Our command:
As you warp and weft rituals and laws, for the people a model standard, having them secure in duties and work, with none changing intentions, therefore employ bestowment on you a Great Chariot and War Chariot, one of each, dark stallions of two teams of four. 
You encourage duty and attending to roots, the harvesters to dusk labor, <a href="#annotation-89" id="source-89">[89]</a> grain and silk amassed and accumulated, the great enterprise thus flourishing, therefore employ bestowment on you the dress of Robe and Cap, Red Shoes to match. 
You esteem modesty and deference, causing the people to improve their conduct, young and grown have courtesy, above and below all harmonized, therefore employ bestowment on you Balcony Hanging [musical instruments], Six Rows of Dancers. 
You assist and declare moral cultivation, thus spreading in the four directions, the distant peoples change face, Huáxià enriched and full, therefore employ bestowment on you Vermillion Doors for your residence. 
You study the enlightened sages, ponder what Emperors find difficult, employ the talented and appoint the worthy, all the good certain to be raised, therefore employ bestowment on you an Entrance Ramp to ascend. 
You maintain the state’s authority, with stern expression occupying the center, of the smallest and slightest of evils, none are not stamped out and removed, therefore employ bestowment on you Tiger Elite guards of three hundred men.
You examine and respect Heaven’s punishments, exposing those with guilt, <a href="#annotation-90" id="source-90">[90]</a> of those that violate order, none are not executed and eradicated, therefore employ bestowment on you Ax and Battle-Ax, one of each.
You soar like a dragon and glare like a tiger, watching the eight directions,  suppressing the rebellious, charging through the Four Seas, therefore employ bestowment on you red bow of one, red arrows of one hundred, black bows of ten, black arrows of one thousand.
You take warmth and humility as foundation, filial piety and fraternal friendship as virtue, intelligently faithful sincerely truthful, emotionally moving Our thoughts, therefore employ bestowment on you libation liquor of one bottle, with jade ladle to match. 
Wèi State is to install an Assistant Chancellor on down, various ministers and hundred offices, all by the regulations of the vassal Marquesses and Kings at the beginning of Hàn. Go forth in veneration! Respectfully obey Our command! Inspect and give relief to your multitudes, in time shine with numerous achievements, employ to the end your illustrious virtues, to repay and raise up Our Gāozǔ’s glorious Mandate! <a href="#annotation-91" id="source-91">[91]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
朕聞先王並建明德，胙之以土，分之以民，崇其寵章，備其禮物，所以藩衛王室，左右厥世也。其在周成，管、蔡不靜，懲難念功，乃使邵康公賜齊太公履，東至於海，西至於河，南至於穆陵，北至於無棣，五侯九伯，實得征之，世祚太師，以表東海；爰及襄王，亦有楚人不供王職，又命晉文登為侯伯，錫以二輅、虎賁、鈇鉞、秬鬯、弓矢，大啟南陽，世作盟主。故周室之不壞，繄二國是賴。今君稱丕顯德，明保朕躬，奉答天命，導揚弘烈，緩爰九域，莫不率俾，〔六〕功高於伊、周，而賞卑於齊、晉，朕甚恧焉。朕以眇眇之身，託於兆民之上，永思厥艱，若涉淵冰，非君攸濟，朕無任焉。今以冀州之河東、河內、魏郡、趙國、中山、常山、鉅鹿、安平、甘陵、平原凡十郡，封君為魏公。錫君玄土，苴以白茅；爰契爾龜，用建冢社。昔在周室，畢公、毛公入為卿佐，周、邵師保出為二伯，外內之任，君實宜之，其以丞相領冀州牧如故。又加君九錫，其敬聽朕命。以君經緯禮律，為民軌儀，使安職業，無或遷志，是用錫君大輅、戎輅各一，玄牡二駟。君勸分務本，穡人昏作，〔七〕粟帛滯積，大業惟興，是用錫君袞冕之服，赤舄副焉。君敦尚謙讓，俾民興行，少長有禮，上下咸和，是用錫君軒縣之樂，六佾之舞。君翼宣風化，爰發四方，遠人革面，華夏充實，是用錫君朱戶以居。君研其明哲，思帝所難，官才任賢，群善必舉，是用錫君納陛以登。君秉國之鈞，正色處中，纖毫之惡，靡不抑退，是用錫君虎賁之士三百人。君糾虔天刑，章厥有罪，〔八〕犯關干紀，莫不誅殛，是用錫君鈇鉞各一。君龍驤虎視，旁眺八維，掩討逆節，折衝四海，是用錫君彤弓一，彤矢百，玈弓十，玈矢千。君以溫恭為基，孝友為德，明允篤誠，感于朕思，是用錫君秬鬯一卣，珪瓚副焉。魏國置丞相已下群卿百寮，皆如漢初諸侯王之制。往欽哉，敬服朕命！簡恤爾眾，時亮庶功，用終爾顯德，對揚我高祖之休命！〔九〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-83" id="annotation-83">[83]</a> Xù Hàn shū states: [Chī] Lǜ appellation Hóngyù was a Shānyáng Gāopíng man.  As a youth he received teachings from Zhèng Xuān,  at Jiàn’ān’s beginning became an Attendant Central.

Yú Pǔ’s Jiāngbiǎo zhuàn  states: Emperor Xiàn once specially met [Chī] Lǜ and Minister Treasurer Kǒng Róng, and asked [Kǒng] Róng saying: “Hóngyù has what exceptional strengths?” [Kǒng] Róng said: “Can adhere to principles, cannot be given authority.”  [Chī] Lǜ raised his tablet and said: “[Kǒng] Róng in the past governed Běihǎi, his governance was disordered and the people wandered. Where was his authority?”  Therefore he and [Kǒng] Róng criticized each other’s strengths and shortcomings, to the point that they were not at peace. The Excellency wrote letters to conciliate them. [Chī] Lǜ from Minister of Staff  was promoted to Grandee.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　續漢書曰：慮字鴻豫，山陽高平人。少受業于鄭玄，建安初為侍中。虞溥江表傳曰：獻帝嘗特見慮及少府孔融，問融曰：「鴻豫何所優長？」融曰：「可與適道，未可與權。」慮舉笏曰：「融昔宰北海，政散民流，其權安在也！」遂與融互相長短，以至不睦。公以書和解之。慮從光祿勳遷為大夫。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-84" id="annotation-84">[84]</a> Gōngyáng Zhuàn states: The Lord like superfluous tassel.  

Hé Xiū  says: ‘Superfluous’ is like ‘dangling.’ ‘Tassel’ is a flag’s tassel. The tassel metaphor is to say it was like being waved east and west by those below.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　公羊傳曰：「君若贅旒然。」何休云：「贅猶綴也。旒，旂旒也。以旒譬者，言為下所執持東西也。」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-85" id="annotation-85">[85]</a> Wén-hóu zhī Mìng states: Also pondering former rectifiers.  

Zhèng Xuán says: ‘Former rectifiers’ means former ministers. It means the Excellencies and Ministers and Grandees.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔三〕　文侯之命曰：「亦惟先正。」鄭玄云：「先正，先臣。謂公卿大夫也。」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-86" id="annotation-86">[86]</a> Zuǒshì Zhuàn states: The various lords left their seats to guard the king’s government. 

Fú Qián  states: It says that the various lords left their own governments to assist the Royal House.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔四〕　左氏傳曰：「諸侯釋位以閒王政。」服虔曰：「言諸侯釋其私政而佐王室。」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-87" id="annotation-87">[87]</a> Shī states: Delivering the finality of Heaven, at the field of Herders. 

Zhèng Xuán says: ‘Finality’ is end.

Hóngfàn states: Gǔn then was ended and died. 
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔五〕　詩曰：「致天之屆，于牧之野。」鄭玄云：「屆，極也。」鴻範曰：「鯀則殛死。」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-88" id="annotation-88">[88]</a> Pán Gēng  states: Pacified thereupon the multitudes.

Zhèng Xuán states: ‘Thereupon’ is ‘to’. Calm tranquility to his multitudes.

Jūn Shì  states: From the sea came out the sun, none were not led as followers.

Led means to adhere. Follower means employed. From the corner of the Four Seas, the sun comes out to shine, and none are not made to adhere and can be employed.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔六〕　盤庚曰：「綏爰有眾。」鄭玄曰：「爰，於也，安隱於其眾也。」君奭曰：「海隅出日，罔不率俾。」率，循也。俾，使也。四海之隅，日出所照，無不循度而可使也。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-89" id="annotation-89">[89]</a> Pán Gēng states: The degenerate farmer at ease with himself, not to dusk making labors.

Zhèng Xuán says: ‘To dusk’ means strenuously.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔七〕　盤庚曰：「墮農自安，不昏作勞。」鄭玄云：「昏，勉也。」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-90" id="annotation-90">[90]</a> “Examined and respected Heavenly punishment” is quoted from the Guóyǔ.  Wéi Zhāo’s  annotation states: ‘Examined’ is investigated. ‘Respected’ is revered. ‘Punishment’ is law.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔八〕　「糾虔天刑」語出國語，韋昭注曰：「糾，察也。虔，敬也。刑，法也。」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-91" id="annotation-91">[91]</a> This was Later Hàn’s Secretariat Writers Left Deputy Pān Xù’s composition. [Pān] Xù appellation Yuánmào was a Chénliú Zhōngmù man. 

Wèi shū records the Excellency’s Order stating: “One to receive the Nine Bestowments, expand and open territory, Zhōu-gōng was that sort of man. Hàn’s eight Kings of different surnames with Gāozǔ together rose in plain clothes,  founded and settled the Ruler’s Enterprise, their achievements the largest. How can I compare with them?” Beginning to end thrice declined.

Thereupon Central Army Preceptor and Língshù precinct Marquess Xún Yōu,  Front Army Preceptor and Dōngwǔ precinct Marquess Zhōng Yáo, Left Army Preceptor Liáng Mào, Right Army Preceptor Máo Jiè,  Pacifying Caitiffs General and Huá village Marquess Liú Xūn,  Establishing Warfare General and Qīngyuán precinct Marquess Liú Ruò,  Subduing Waves General and Gāo’ān Marquess Xiàhóu Dūn,  Raising Warfare General and city precinct Marquess Wáng Zhōng,  Exerting Authority General and Yuè village Marquess Liú Zhǎn,  Establishing Loyalty General and Chāngxiāng precinct Marquess Xiānyú Fǔ,  Exerting Warfare General and Ānguó precinct Marquess Chéng Yù,  Grand Central Grandee and city village Marquess Jiǎ Xǔ,  Army Preceptor Libationer Qiānqiū precinct Marquess Dǒng Zhāo,  city precinct Marquess Xuē Hóng,  Nánxiāng precinct Marquess Dǒng Méng,  Within the Passes Marquess Wáng Càn, Fù Xùn, Libationers Wáng Xuǎn, Yuán Huàn, Wáng Lǎng, Chāng Chéng, Rèn Fān, Dù Xí,  Central Protector of the Army and Guómíng precinct Marquess Cáo Hóng,  Central Manager of the Army and Wànsuì precinct Marquess Hán Hào,  Acting Valiant Cavalry General and Ānpíng precinct Marquess Cáo Rén,  designate Protector of the Army General Wáng Tú,  Chief Scribes Wàn Qián, Xiè Huàn, Yuán Bà  and others encouraged the advancement stating:

“From since the ancient Three Dynasties,  granting ministers with land, receiving commands for internal restoration, enfeoffments and titles to supporting assistants, was all to commend achievement and reward virtue, to serve as vassal defenses for the state. Previously, Heaven’s Under collapsed into chaos, crowds of vicious and powerful rose, the danger of overstepping bounds and domineering insolence, one cannot bear to speak of it. Your Enlightened Excellency exerted your body and devoted your life to face these troubles, punished the rebellion of the two Yuán’s usurpation and thieving, exterminated the sorts of the Huángjīn’s banditry and chaos, destroyed and razed the leaders of rebels, cut down and weeded the wild filth, bathed in frost and dew for over twenty years. From since there has been writing, there has never been achievements like this. In the past, Zhōu-gōng continued the legacy of Wén and Wǔ, received an already completed enterprise, rested high on writing brush, saluted to greet the various lords, the labors of Shāng-Yǎn were no more than two years;  Lǚ Wàng used the circumstances of having two out of three to hold power over eight hundred vassal lords, temporarily held banner and battle-ax, for a time directed signal flag;  however both greatly founded lands, striding provinces and merging states. Zhōu-gōng’s eight sons all were marquesses and earls, white bulls and red oxen, Suburb Sacrifices to Heaven and Earth, ritual tallies and prepared objects in imitation of the Ruling House, their glorious esteem and flourishing favor was as vast as this.  Reaching to Hàn’s rise, the ministers assisting the mandate were Zhāng Ěr and Wú Ruì, their achievements were extremely meager, but they also linked cities and opened territory, faced south and declared themselves sovereign.  These were all enlightened lords and understanding rulers conveying it above, worth ministers and sagely governors receiving it below, the virtuous standards of the Three Dynasties, the enlightened regulations of the Hàn Emperors. Now in comparing labors then Zhōu [gōng] and Lǚ [Wàng] had it easy, in calculating achievements then Zhāng [Ěr] and Wú [Ruì] were small, in discussing regulation standards then Qí and Lǔ were weightier, in speaking of territory then Chángshā was more.  That being the case, the fief of Wèi state and the honor of the Nine Bestowments, compared to the ancient rewards, is like hiding jade under coarse clothes.  Moreover, the Ranked Marquesses and various officers who will by fortunate connection to a dragon stallion be able to steal small labors to girdle purple and hold gold  are altogether in the hundreds, and also will because of this be able to transmit inheritances for myriad generations, but if Your Enlightened Excellency alone declines reward above, it will cause those below to feel ill at ease,  above violate the joyous hearts of the Sagely Court, below fail the utmost hopes of the capped and girdled,  forgetting the great enterprise of supporting assistance, trusting in the meager conduct of a common fellow, this is what we [Xún] Yōu and the rest greatly fear.” Therefore the Excellency ordered the exterior to make a Reply, but only to receive Wèi prefecture. [Xún] Yōu and the rest again said: “In prostration observing: In the original enfeoffment of Wèi state, the Sagely Court considered carefully, consulted and planned with the various bureaus, and only then afterward issued the mandate, but Your Enlightened Excellency for a long time opposed the Superior’s direction, not accepting the great gifts. Now to have already reverently accepted the Edict mandate, to complement and obey the expectations of the masses, but also to wish to decline much and accept little, yielding nine and accepting one, it is like the reward of the Hàn Court reward not being enacted, and so the request of [Xún] Yōu and the rest not being approved. In the past the enfeoffments of Qí and Lǔ covered all to the East Sea, the territory tax revenue was four million families, the foundations prosperous and industry expansive, easy to use to establish achievement, and therefore able to achieve the accomplishments of supporting and carrying, establish the merit of unified rectification. Now although Wèi state is ten prefectures in name, yet it is less than Qūfù,  in calculating its household numbers, it cannot even be half. To be a vassal guard for the Ruling House, establishing walls and planting screens, it appears not yet sufficient. Moreover, the Sagely Superior has observed the disaster of Qín falling without support,  has been warned by the hardships of the shaking disturbances of former days, entrusts and establishes the loyal and worthy, for [the prevention of] decline and fall, may Your Enlightened Excellency respectfully receive the Emperor’s mandate, and no longer refuse and disobey.” The Excellency thus accepted the mandate.

Wèi lüè records the Excellency’s sent up letter of thanks stating: “Your Servant was immersed in the Former Emperor’s generous favor, reaching rank in the cadet bureaus. By nature being languid and idle, my intentions and hopes were completely fulfilled, not daring to wish for high rank, hope for prestige and influence. It happened that Dǒng Zhuó made chaos, righteousness is to die for a cause, and therefore I dared exert body and devote life, breaking charges and leading multitudes, and therefore in happening to encounter an opportunity of a thousand years, I served in the labors before your eyes. At the interval when the two Yuán were domineering and oppressive, Your Majesty  and Your Servant were cold in heart and alike in anxieties, looking back to gaze to the capital, advancing to receive a ferocious enemy, always afraid that we lord and servant would together fall into the tiger’s mouth, truly I had no expectation that I would be able to preserve my head and neck. Depending on the blessings of the Ancestral spirits, the villainous sorts were exterminated, allowing Your Meager Servant to steal some reputation in the meantime.  Your Majesty applied favor, appointing me as the highest minister, fief and noble rank and favors and salary, abundant and great and vast and generous. Of my entire life’s wishes, I truly had not expected it. The calculations of my mouth and of heart is that it is good fortune to remain to await punishment,  preserve and keep my Ranked Marquisate, bequeath it to my sons and grandsons, entrust myself to your sagely reign, and forever be without worry and blame. Unexpectedly Your Majesty then showed greater intentions, opening a state and preparing bestowments, to confer on Your Foolish Servant, the territory comparable to Qí and Lǔ, the rituals the same as to the vassal kings, not what Your Servant without achievements should receive and hold. Submitting my feelings above to be heard, it was not favored with acceptance and permission, stern Edict harshly arrived, truly causing Your Servant’s heart to rise and fall in the pressure. In prostration examining myself, ranked among the great ministers, fate controlled by the Ruling House, my body is not my own possession, how can I dare have selfishness, to follow these foolish thoughts, to be dismissed and wear my original [commoner] clothes? Now in accepting the territory, preparing to serve as vassal assistant, I do not dare think for the long term and worry of having later generations [of descendants]. As for me and my sons, we together swear oaths to the end of our lives, disintegrating bodies and exhausting fates, to repay the generous favor. With Heaven’s authority at front, in fear I accept the Edict.”
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔九〕　後漢尚書左丞潘勗之辭也。勗字元茂，陳留中牟人。魏書載公令曰：「夫受九錫，廣開土宇，周公其人也。漢之異姓八王者，與高祖俱起布衣，創定王業，其功至大，吾何可比之？」前後三讓。於是中軍師（王）陸樹亭侯荀攸、前軍師東武亭侯鍾繇、左軍師涼茂、右軍師毛玠、平虜將軍華鄉侯劉勳、建武將軍清苑亭侯劉若、伏波將軍高安侯夏侯惇、揚武將軍都亭侯王忠、奮威將軍樂鄉侯劉展、建忠將軍昌鄉亭侯鮮于輔、奮武將軍安國亭侯程昱、太中大夫都鄉侯賈詡、軍師祭酒千秋亭侯董昭、都亭侯薛洪、南鄉亭侯董蒙、關內侯王粲、傅巽、祭酒王選、袁渙、王朗、張承、任藩、杜襲、中護軍國明亭侯曹洪、中領軍萬歲亭侯韓浩、行驍騎將軍安平亭侯曹仁、領護軍將軍王圖、長史萬潛、謝奐、袁霸等勸進曰：「自古三代，胙臣以土，受命中興，封秩輔佐，皆所以褒功賞德，為國藩衛也。往者天下崩亂，群凶豪起，顛越跋扈之險，不可忍言。明公奮身出命以徇其難，誅二袁篡盜之逆，滅黃巾賊亂之類，殄夷首逆，芟撥荒穢，沐浴霜露二十餘年，書契已來，未有若此功者。昔周公承文、武之跡，受已成之業，高枕墨筆，拱揖群后，商、奄之勤，不過二年，呂望因三分有二之形，據八百諸侯之勢，暫把旄鉞，一時指麾，然皆大啟土宇，跨州兼國。周公八子，並為侯伯，白牡騂剛，郊祀天地，典策備物，擬則王室，榮章寵盛如此之弘也。逮至漢興，佐命之臣，張耳、吳芮，其功至薄，亦連城開地，南面稱孤。此皆明君達主行之於上，賢臣聖宰受之於下，三代令典，漢帝明制。今比勞則周、呂逸，計功則張、吳微，論制則齊、魯重，言地則長沙多；然則魏國之封，九錫之榮，況於舊賞，猶懷玉而被褐也。且列侯諸將，幸攀龍驥，得竊微勞，佩紫懷黃，蓋以百數，亦將因此傳之萬世，而明公獨辭賞於上，將使其下懷不自安，上違聖朝歡心，下失冠帶至望，忘輔弼之大業，信匹夫之細行，攸等所大懼也。」於是公敕外為章，但受魏郡。攸等復曰：「伏見魏國初封，聖朝發慮，稽謀群寮，然後策命；而明公久違上指，不即大禮。今既虔奉詔命，副順眾望，又欲辭多當少，讓九受一，是猶漢朝之賞不行，而攸等之請未許也。昔齊、魯之封，奄有東海，疆域井賦，四百萬家，基隆業廣，易以立功，故能成翼戴之勳，立一匡之績。今魏國雖有十郡之名，猶減于曲阜，計其戶數，不能參半，以藩衛王室，立垣樹屏，猶未足也。且聖上覽亡秦無輔之禍，懲曩日震蕩之艱，託建忠賢，廢墜是為，願明公恭承帝命，無或拒違。」公乃受命。魏略載公上書謝曰：「臣蒙先帝厚恩，致位郎署，受性疲怠，意望畢足，非敢希望高位，庶幾顯達。會董卓作亂，義當死難，故敢奮身出命，摧鋒率眾，遂值千載之運，奉役目下。當二袁炎沸侵侮之際，陛下與臣寒心同憂，顧瞻京師，進受猛敵，常恐君臣俱陷虎口，誠不自意能全首領。賴祖宗靈祐，醜類夷滅，得使微臣竊名其間。陛下加恩，授以上相，封爵寵祿，豐大弘厚，生平之願，實不望也。口與心計，幸且待罪，保持列侯，遺付子孫，自託聖世，永無憂責。不意陛下乃發盛意，開國備錫，以貺愚臣，地比齊、魯，禮同藩王，非臣無功所宜膺據。歸情上聞，不蒙聽許，嚴詔切至，誠使臣心俯仰逼迫。伏自惟省，列在大臣，命制王室，身非己有，豈敢自私，遂其愚意，亦將黜退，令就初服。今奉疆土，備數藩翰，非敢遠期，慮有後世；至於父子相誓終身，灰軀盡命，報塞厚恩。天威在顏，悚懼受詔。」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Autumn, Seventh Moon [213 Aug 5 – Sep 2], began establishment of the Wèi State Altars and Ancestral Temple. Heaven’s Son was betrothed to three daughters of the Duke as Noble Ladies, the youngest waited to come of age in [Wèi] state. <a href="#annotation-92" id="source-92">[92]</a> Ninth Moon [213 Oct 3 – Oct 31], built Jīnhǔtái, dug canals to draw the Zhāng river to enter the Bái canal to connect to the Hé. 
Winter, Tenth Moon [213 Nov 1 – Nov 30], divided Wèi prefecture into east and west divisions, installing Commandants.
Eleventh Moon [213 Dec 1 – Dec 29], first installed [Wèi] Secretariat Writers, Attendant Centrals, Six Ministers. <a href="#annotation-93" id="source-93">[93]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
秋七月，始建魏社稷宗廟。天子聘公三女為貴人，少者待年于國。〔一〕九月，作金虎臺，鑿渠引漳水入白溝以通河。冬十月，分魏郡為東西部，置都尉。十一月，初置尚書、侍中、六卿。〔二〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-92" id="annotation-92">[92]</a> Xiān-dì Qǐjū zhù states: Sent Envoy Holding Stave Acting as Minister of Ceremonies the Minister of Agriculture and Ānyáng precinct Marquess Wáng Yì  to present jade rings, silk, black and pale red, fabric of fifty thousand pǐ to Yè as betrothal gifts, armored escort of five men, all as Consultant Cadets enacting Grandee affairs, assistant armored of one man.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　獻帝起居注曰：使使持節行太常大司農安陽亭侯王邑，齎璧、帛、玄纁、絹五萬匹之鄴納聘，介者五人，皆以議郎行大夫事，副介一人。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-93" id="annotation-93">[93]</a> Wèishì Chūnqiū states: Appointed Xún Yōu as Secretariat Writers Director, Liáng Mào as Deputy Director, Máo Jiè, Cuī Yǎn, Cháng Lín, Xú Yì, Hé Kuí as Secretariat Writers, Wáng Càn, Dù Xí, Wèi Jì, Hé Qià as Attendant Centrals.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　魏氏春秋曰：以荀攸為尚書令，涼茂為僕射，毛玠、崔琰、常林、徐奕、何夔為尚書，王粲、杜襲、衛覬、和洽為侍中。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Mǎ Chāo was at Hànyáng, again took advantage of the Qiāng and Hú to do harm. Dī King Qiānwàn rebelled in support of [Mǎ] Chāo, garrisoned Xīngguó.  Sent Xiàhóu Yuān to suppress them.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
馬超在漢陽，復因羌、胡為害，氐王千萬叛應超，屯興國。使夏侯淵討之。
:::
:::

## Jiàn'ān 19 - 20 (214 - 215) {.unnumbered}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Nineteenth Year, Spring, Standard Moon [214 Jan 29 – Feb 26], first plowed the Register Field.  Nán’ān’s Zhào Qú, Hànyáng’s Yǐn Fèng and others suppressed [Mǎ] Chāo, exposed the heads of his wives and children.  [Mǎ] Chāo fled to Hànzhōng. Hán Suì relocated to Jīnchéng, entered Dī King Qiānwàn’s division, led Qiāng and Hú of over ten thousand cavalry to battle with Xiàhóu Yuān. Struck, greatly defeated them. [Hán] Suì fled to Xīpíng.  [Xiàhóu] Yuān with the various officers attacked Xīngguó, slaughtered it. Abolished Āndōng and Yǒngyáng prefectures.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
十九年春正月，始耕籍田。南安趙衢、漢陽尹奉等討超，梟其妻子，超奔漢中。韓遂徙金城，入氐王千萬部，率羌、胡萬餘騎與夏侯淵戰，擊，大破之，遂走西平。淵與諸將攻興國，屠之。省安東、永陽郡。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
When Āndìng Administrator Guànqiū Xīng  was about to take office, the Duke warmed him saying: “The Qiāng and Hú wish to connect with the central states, and should send people to come [to us], be careful to not send people to go [to them]. Good men are difficult to find, [so anyone sent] will certainly teach the Qiāng and Hú to make absurd requests, because he wishes to profit himself. To not agree then will disappoint the expectations of the foreigners, to agree to it then will have no benefits.” [Guànqiū] Xīng arrived, sent Colonel Fàn Líng among the Qiāng, [Fàn] Líng indeed instructed the Qiāng to request him to be their Dependent State Commandant.  The Duke said: “I foresaw it would be like this, not because I am a sage, only because my experiences are many.” <a href="#annotation-94" id="source-94">[94]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
安定太守毌丘興將之官，公戒之曰：「羌，胡欲與中國通，自當遣人來，慎勿遣人往。善人難得，必將教羌、胡妄有所請求，因欲以自利；不從便為失異俗意，從之則無益事。」興至，遣校尉范陵至羌中，陵果教羌，使自請為屬國都尉。公曰：「吾預知當爾，非聖也，但更事多耳。」〔一〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-94" id="annotation-94">[94]</a> Xiàn-dì Qǐjū zhù states: Sent Enacting Minister of Ceremonies affairs the Minister of Agriculture Ānyáng precinct Marquess Wáng Yì with Minister of the Imperial Clan Liú Ài, both Holding Stave, armored escort of five men, to present bundles of silk and teams of four horses, with the Dispensing Affairs Yellow Gate Attendant Cadet, the Lateral Court Deputy, Central Regular Attendants of two men, to welcome the two Noble Ladies from Wèi Duchy State.  Second Moon, Guǐhài [214 Mar 10], also at the Duke of Wèi’s Ancestral Temples conferred Seals and Ribbons on the two Noble Ladies. Jiǎzǐ [214 Mar 11], visited the Duke of Wèi’s Palace’s Yánqiū Gate, welcomed the Noble Ladies to board the carriages. Wèi sent its Minister of Cadets, Minister Treasurer, Academic Scholars, Imperial Storehouses and Chénghuáng Stable Director, Assistant Chancellor’s Assistants and Associates and Attendants to escort the Noble Ladies.  Guǐyǒu [214 Mar 20], the two Noble Ladies reached Wěicāng’s interior. Sent [Hàn] Attendant Centrals, Dānjiāng Surplus Followers, Tiger Elite beginning to end continuously to welcome them.  Yǐhài [214 Mar 22], the two Noble Ladies entered the Palace, the Censorate Grandee, Central Two Thousand dàn  officers and grandees, Consultant Cadets gathered inside the Hall, Wèi State’s two Ministers with an Attendant Central and Central Cadet, two men, with Hàn’s Excellencies and Ministers together ascended the Hall and feasted.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　獻帝起居注曰：使行太常事大司農安陽亭侯王邑與宗正劉艾，皆持節，介者五人，齎束帛駟馬，及給事黃門侍郎、掖庭丞、中常侍二人，迎二貴人于魏公國。二月癸亥，又於魏公宗廟授二貴人印綬。甲子，詣魏公宮延秋門，迎貴人升車。魏遣郎中令、少府、博士、御府乘黃廄令、丞相掾屬侍送貴人。癸酉，二貴人至洧倉中，遣侍中丹將冗從虎賁前後駱驛往迎之。乙亥，二貴人入宮，御史大夫、中二千石將大夫、議郎會殿中，魏國二卿及侍中、中郎二人，與漢公卿並升殿宴。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Third Moon [214 Mar 29 – Apr 26], Heaven’s Son had the Duke of Wèi ranked above the vassal Marquesses and Kings, changed the conferment to Gold Ruler’s Seal and Red Cord, Distant Travels Cap. <a href="#annotation-95" id="source-95">[95]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
三月，天子使魏公位在諸侯王上，改授金璽，赤紱、遠遊冠〔一〕。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-95" id="annotation-95">[95]</a> Xiān-dì Qǐjū zhù states: Sent Left Central Cadet General Yáng Xuān and precinct Marquess Péi Mào Holding Stave and Seal to confer them.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　獻帝起居注曰：使左中郎將楊宣亭侯裴茂持節、印授之。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Autumn, Seventh Moon [214 Aug 23 – Sep 21], the Duke campaigned against Sūn Quán. <a href="#annotation-96" id="source-96">[96]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
秋七月，公征孫權。〔一〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-96" id="annotation-96">[96]</a> Jiǔzhōu Chūnqiū states: Advisor to the Army Fù Gàn  remonstrated saying: “The greatest tools for governing Heaven’s Under are two: the Civil and the Martial.  In using the Martial then prioritize power, in using the Civil then prioritize virtue. When power and virtue are sufficient to support one another, only afterward is the Ruler’s Way fulfilled. Previously Heaven’s Under was in great chaos, above and below lost their order, Your Enlightened Excellency employed the Martial to suppress it, out of ten pacifying nine. Now those not yet serving the ruler’s commands are Wú and Shǔ. Wú has the barrier of the Cháng Jiāng, Shǔ has the obstructions of the lofty mountains,  difficult to subdue with power, easy to embrace with virtue. I humbly believe it possible to temporarily shelve armor and store weapons, rest the army and nurture the servicemen, divide land and determine fiefs, discuss achievements and enact rewards. If this is done then the hearts inside and outside are stabilized, those with achievements are encouraged, and then Heaven’s Under will understand regulation. Then afterward gradually raise learning and schools, to guide their good natures and expand their righteous integrity. Your Excellency’s divine Martial ability shakes the Four Seas, if you cultivate the Civil to aid it, then of all that are Under the Heavens, none will think to not submit. Now you raise multitudes of a hundred thousand, arranging them on the shores of the Cháng Jiāng, if the rebels rely on terrain to hide in the depths, then the servicemen and horses will not be able to display their abilities, the special and adaptive [strategies] will have no way to employ their effects, and then great power would be weakened and the enemy hearts would be unable to be subdued. May Your Enlightened Excellency ponder the meaning of Yú Shùn’s dance with shield and ax,  preserve power and nurture virtue, and by principle establish victory.” The Duke did not listen, the army therefore was without achievements. [Fù] Gān appellation Yàncái was a Běidì man, ended as Assistant Chancellor’s Granary Department Associate, had a son named [Fù] Xuán.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　九州春秋曰：參軍傅幹諫曰：「治天下之大具有二，文與武也；用武則先威，用文則先德，威德足以相濟，而後王道備矣。往者天下大亂，上下失序，明公用武攘之，十平其九。今未承王命者，吳與蜀也，吳有長江之險，蜀有崇山之阻，難以威服，易以德懷。愚以為可且按甲寢兵，息軍養士，分土定封，論功行賞，若此則內外之心固，有功者勸，而天下知制矣。然後漸興學校，以導其善性而長其義節。公神武震於四海，若脩文以濟之，則普天之下，無思不服矣。今舉十萬之眾，頓之長江之濱，若賊負固深藏，則士馬不能逞其能，奇變無所用其權，則大威有屈而敵心未能服矣。唯明公思虞舜舞干戚之義，全威養德，以道制勝。」公不從，軍遂無功。幹字彥材，北地人，終於丞相倉曹屬。有子曰玄。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Previously, Lǒngxī’s Sòng Jiàn declared himself Héshǒu Píng-Hàn King, gathered multitudes at Fūhǎn, changed Inaugurals, installed a Hundred Officials, for over thirty years.  Sent Xiàhóu Yuān from Xīngguó to suppress him. Winter, Tenth Moon [214 Nov 20 – Dec 19], slaughtered Fūhǎn, beheaded [Sòng] Jiàn, Liáng Province was pacified.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
初，隴西宋建自稱河首平漢王，聚眾枹罕，改元，置百官，三十餘年。遣夏侯淵自興國討之。冬十月，屠枹罕，斬建，涼州平。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
The Duke from Héféi returned.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
公自合肥還。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Eleventh Moon [214 Dec 20 – 215 Jan 17], Hàn Imperial Empress Fú-shì was connected to previously sending a letter to her father, the former Garrison Cavalry Colonel [Fú] Wán, saying that the Emperor, because Dǒng Chéng had been executed, blamed and resented the Duke, the words extremely harsh and foul. Discovered, the Empress was deposed and died, her brothers all submitted to execution. <a href="#annotation-97" id="source-97">[97]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
十一月，漢皇后伏氏坐昔與父故屯騎校尉完書，云帝以董承被誅怨恨公，辭甚醜惡，發聞，后廢黜死，兄弟皆伏法。〔一〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-97" id="annotation-97">[97]</a> Cáo Mán zhuàn states: The Duke sent Huà Xīn to lead soldiers to enter the Palace to arrest the Empress. The Empress obstructed the doors and hide in the walls. [Huà] Xīn broke down the doors and opened the walls and dragged the Empress out. The Emperor at the time was seated with Censorate Grandee Chī Lǜ. The Empress with disheveled hair and walking barefooted passed and grasped the Emperor’s hand saying: “Can you not again save my life?” The Emperor said: “I also do not know my own fate will be at what time.” The Emperor said to [Chī] Lǜ: “Excellency Chī, Under Heaven how can there be such a thing?” Therefore led away the Empress and killed her, of [Fú] Wán with his clansmen the dead were several hundred people.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　曹瞞傳曰：公遣華歆勒兵入宮收后，后閉戶匿壁中。歆壞戶發壁，牽后出。帝時與御史大夫郗慮坐，后被髮徒跣過，執帝手曰：「不能復相活邪？」帝曰：「我亦不自知命在何時也。」帝謂慮曰：「郗公，天下寧有是邪！」遂將后殺之，完及宗族死者數百人。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Twelfth Moon [215 Jan 18 – Feb 16], the Duke reached Mèngjīn. Heaven’s Son mandated the Duke set Banner Heads, Palace Halls establish Bells and Stands.  Yǐwèi [215 Feb 5], Order said: “Servicemen of good conduct are not necessarily able to advance and succeed, servicemen of advancement and success are not necessarily able to have good conduct. Did Chén Píng act with sincerity? Did Sū Qín keep faith? Yet Chén Píng settled Hàn’s enterprise, Sū Qín rescued a weak Yān.  By this discussing it, [even if a] serviceman has particular shortcomings, how can he be discarded? If the relevant managers understand and ponder this principle, then servicemen will not be overlooked, and offices will have no unfulfilled duties.” It also said: “Punishment is about the lives of the Hundred Surnames, but if inside the army of those managing imprisonment some are not the right people, and yet are appointed in the matters of death or life for the Three Armies,  I am extremely fearful of this. Thus select those of enlightened understanding in law and judgment, to employ them in managing punishments.” Therefore installed Judgment Department Assistant and Associate.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
十二月，公至孟津。天子命公置旄頭，宮殿設鍾虡。乙未，令曰：「夫有行之士未必能進取，進取之士未必能有行也。陳平豈篤行，蘇秦豈守信邪？而陳平定漢業，蘇秦濟弱燕。由此言之，士有偏短，庸可廢乎！有司明思此義，則士無遺滯，官無廢業矣。」又曰：「夫刑，百姓之命也，而軍中典獄者或非其人，而任以三軍死生之事，吾甚懼之。其選明達法理者，使持典刑。」於是置理曹掾屬。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Twentieth Year, Spring, Standard Moon [215 Feb 17 – Mar 17], Heaven’s Son established the Duke’s middle daughter as Imperial Empress.  Abolished Yúnzhōng, Dìngxiāng, Wǔyuán, Shuòfāng prefectures, for each prefecture installed one county to govern its people, united to form Xīnxīng prefecture.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
二十年春正月，天子立公中女為皇后。省雲中、定襄、五原、朔方郡，郡置一縣領其民，合以為新興郡。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Third Moon [215 Apr 17 – May 15], the Duke campaigned west against Zhāng Lǔ, reached Chéncāng, about to from Wǔdū enter the Dī.  The Dī peoples blocked the roads. First sent Zhāng Hé and Zhū Líng and others to attack and defeated them. 
Summer, Fourth Moon [215 May 16 – Jun 14], the Duke from Chéncāng set out Sǎn Pass, reached Héchí. Dī King Dòumào’s multitudes of over ten thousand people relied on the terrain to not submit.  Fifth Moon [215 Jun 15 – Jul 13], the Duke attacked and slaughtered them. Xīpíng’s and Jīnchéng’s various officers Qū Yǎn, Jiǎng Shí, and others together cut off and sent Hán Suì’s head. <a href="#annotation-98" id="source-92">[98]</a>
Autumn, Seventh Moon [215 Aug 13 – Sep 10], the Duke reached Yángpíng. Zhāng Lǔ sent his younger brother [Zhāng] Wèi with his officer Yáng Áng to occupy Yángpíng Pass,  along the mountains building fortifications for over ten lǐ. Attacked them, could not capture them, and so led the army back. The rebels saw the main army had retreated, their defense preparations loosened and scattered. The Duke then secretly sent Xiè Biāo, Gāo Zuò, and others to climb over the terrain in a night attack, greatly defeated them, beheaded their officer Yáng Rèn,  advanced to attack [Zhāng] Wèi, [Zhāng] Wèi and the rest in the night escaped, [Zhāng] Lǔ fled to Bāzhōng.  The Duke’s army entered Nánzhèng, completely captured [Zhāng] Lǔ’s offices and storehouses and treasures. <a href="#annotation-99" id="source-99">[99]</a> Bā and Hàn[zhōng] all surrendered. Reverted Hànníng prefecture to Hànzhōng,  divided Hànzhōng’s Ānyáng and Xīchéng to form Xīchéng prefecture, installing an Administrator. Divided out Xī and Shàngyōng prefectures, installing Commandants.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
三月，公西征張魯，至陳倉，將自武都入氐；氐人塞道，先遣張郃、朱靈等攻破之。夏四月，公自陳倉以出散關，至河池。氐王竇茂眾萬餘人，恃險不服，五月，公攻屠之。西平、金城諸將麴演、蔣石等共斬送韓遂首。〔一〕秋七月，公至陽平。張魯使弟衛與將楊昂等據陽平關，橫山築城十餘里，攻之不能拔，乃引軍還。賊見大軍退，其守備解散。公乃密遣解〈忄剽〉、高祚等乘險夜襲，大破之，斬其將楊任，進攻衛，衛等夜遁，魯潰奔巴中。公軍入南鄭，盡得魯府庫珍寶。〔二〕巴、漢皆降。復漢寧郡為漢中；分漢中之安陽、西城為西城郡，置太守；分錫、上庸郡，置都尉。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-98" id="annotation-98">[98]</a> Diǎnlüè states: [Hán] Suì appellation Wényuē,  originally with his same prefecture’s Biān Zhāng both were famed in the western provinces. [Biān] Zhāng became Supervising Army Following Official,  [Hán] Suì presented accounts to visit the capital, Hé Jìn had formerly heard of his reputation, and specially met with him. [Hán] Suì advised [Hé] Jìn to execute all the castrates, [Hé] Jìn did not listen, and so [Hán Suì] requested to return home. It happened that Liáng Province’s Sòng Yáng and Běigōng Yù and others rebelled,  elected [Biān] Zhāng and [Hán] Suì as their leaders. [Biān] Zhāng soon died of illness, [Hán] Suì was seized by [Sòng] Yáng and the rest, had no choice. [Hán] Suì relied on troops to make chaos, altogether for thirty-two years, reaching to this then he died, his years were over seventy.

Liú Ài’s Líng-dì jì states: [Biān] Zhāng had another name [Biān] Yǔn. 
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　典略曰：遂字文約，始與同郡邊章俱著名西州。章為督軍從事。遂奉計詣京師，何進宿聞其名，特與相見，遂說進使誅諸閹人，進不從，乃求歸。會涼州宋揚、北宮玉等反，舉章、遂為主，章尋病卒，遂為揚等所劫，不得已，遂阻兵為亂，積三十二年，至是乃死，年七十餘矣。劉艾靈帝紀曰：章，一名（元）〔允〕。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-99" id="annotation-99">[99]</a> Wèi shū states: The army from Wǔdū crossed mountains for a thousand lǐ, climbing up and down difficult terrain, the army men fatigued and suffering. The Duke therefore held a great feast, none did not forget their fatigue.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　魏書曰：軍自武都山行千里，升降險阻，軍人勞苦；公於是大饗，莫不忘其勞。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Eighth Moon [215 Sep 11 – Oct 10], Sūn Quán besieged Héféi. Zhāng Liáo and Lǐ Diǎn struck and defeated him.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
八月，孫權圍合肥，張遼、李典擊破之。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Ninth Moon [215 Oct 11 – Nov 8], Bā’s Seven Surnames of Yí King Pǔ Hú and Cóngyì Marquess Dù Huò  led Bā’s Yí and Cóng peoples to come submit, <a href="#annotation-100" id="source-100">[100]</a> therefore divided Bā prefecture, with [Pǔ] Hú as Bādōng Prefecture Administrator, [Dù] Huò as Bāxī Prefecture Administrator,  both enfeoffed as Ranked Marquesses. Heaven’s Son mandated that the Duke undertake regulations  to enfeoff and appoint various Marquesses and Administrators and Chancellors. <a href="#annotation-101" id="source-101">[101]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
九月，巴七姓夷王朴胡、賨邑侯杜濩舉巴夷、賨民來附，〔一〕於是分巴郡，以胡為巴東太守，濩為巴西太守，皆封列侯。天子命公承制封拜諸侯守相。〔二〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-100" id="annotation-100">[100]</a> Sūn Shèng states: Pǔ pronounced Fú. Huò pronounced Hù.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　孫盛曰：朴音浮。濩音戶。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-101" id="annotation-101">[101]</a> Kǒng Yǎn’s Hàn Wèi Chūnqiū  states: Heaven’s Son, because the Duke managed appointments in the exterior, and in overseeing matters of rewards, sometimes it was appropriate to be quick, thus mandated that the Duke be able to undertake regulations to enfeoff and appoint various Marquesses and Administrators and Chancellors. The Edict said: “The greatest matters of the army are in rewards and punishments, to encourage good and discourage evil, it is appropriate to not waste time. Therefore, that the Sīmǎ Fǎ states: ‘Rewards are not to take more than a day,’ is to wish the people to quickly see the benefits of doing good. In the past at the Internal Restoration, Dèng Yǔ entered the Passes and undertook regulations to appoint Army Libationer Lǐ Wén as Hédōng Administrator, Lái Shè also undertook regulations to appoint Gāo Jùn as Connecting Roads General.  Investigating their biographies, both did not first request permission; it is clear that while facing the affairs they carved the seals. This then was Shìzǔ’s  divine brilliance, expediently implementing increases or decreases, overall employing fast demonstrations of power and acceptance, and so established his great achievement. Thus in the principles of the Chūnqiū, grandees sent out to the borders have situations of taking command, only to benefit the State Altars and secure the country and nothing more. Moreover, you maintain the appointment of the Two Governors, Preceptor and Intendant over the Nine Possessions, truly campaigning Yí and Xià,  army traveling beyond the vassal outskirts, losses and gains are decided in instants. Halting rewards to wait for Edict is to hinder worldly affairs, assuredly not what We intend. From now afterward, in facing affairs of evaluation, for those that should be applied with favor and title, then at once carve seals and lend conferment, to enable all the loyal and righteous to obtain immediate rewards and to not have doubts.”
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　孔衍漢魏春秋曰：天子以公典任於外，臨事之賞，或宜速疾，乃命公得承制封拜諸侯守相，詔曰：「夫軍之大事，在茲賞罰，勸善懲惡，宜不旋時，故司馬法曰『賞不逾日』者，欲民速睹為善之利也。昔在中興，鄧禹入關，承制拜軍祭酒李文為河東太守，來歙又承制拜高峻為通路將軍，察其本傳，皆非先請，明臨事刻印也，斯則世祖神明，權達損益，蓋所用速示威懷而著鴻勳也。其春秋之義，大夫出疆，有專命之事，苟所以利社稷安國家而已。況君秉任二伯，師尹九有，實征夷夏，軍行藩甸之外，失得在於斯須之間，停賞俟詔以滯世務，固非朕之所圖也。自今已後，臨事所甄，當加寵號者，其便刻印章假授，咸使忠義得相獎勵，勿有疑焉。」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Winter, Tenth Moon [215 Nov 9 – Dec 8], first installed Nominal Marquess reaching to Fifth Grandee,  with the old Ranked Marquess and Within the Passes Marquess altogether six ranks, to reward army achievements. <a href="#annotation-102" id="source-102">[102]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
冬十月，始置名號侯至五大夫，與舊列侯、關內侯凡六等，以賞軍功。〔一〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-102" id="annotation-102">[102]</a> Wèi shū states: Installed Nominal Marquess title as the eighteenth level, Inside the Passes Marquess title as the seventeenth level, all gold seals and purple ribbons;  also installed Within the Passes Outer Marquess as the sixteenth level, bronze seal with turtle fastening and black ribbon,  Fifth Grandee as the fifteenth level, bronze seal with ring fastening, also black ribbon,  all with no income, with the old Ranked Marquess and Within the Passes Marquess altogether six ranks.

Your Servant Sōngzhī believes: The ‘empty enfeoffments’ of the present probably began from this. 
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏書曰：置名號侯爵十八級，關中侯爵十七級，皆金印紫綬；又置關內外侯十六級，銅印龜紐墨綬；五大夫十五級，銅印環紐，亦墨綬，皆不食租，與舊列侯關內侯凡六等。臣松之以為今之虛封蓋自此始。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Eleventh Moon [215 Dec 9 – 216 Jan 6], [Zhāng] Lǔ from Bāzhōng led his remnant multitudes to surrender. Enfeoffed [Zhāng] Lǔ and his five sons all as Ranked Marquesses. Liú Bèi had attacked [Liú] Zhāng and seized Yì Province, and therefore occupied Bāzhōng. Sent Zhāng Hé to strike him.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
十一月，魯自巴中將其餘眾降。封魯及五子皆為列侯。劉備襲劉璋，取益州，遂據巴中；遣張郃擊之。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Twelfth Moon [216 Jan 7 – Feb 5], the Duke from Nánzhèng returned, leaving Xiàhóu Yuān to garrison Hànzhōng. <a href="#annotation-103" id="source-103">[103]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
十二月，公自南鄭還，留夏侯淵屯漢中。〔一〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-103" id="annotation-103">[103]</a> During the journey, Attendant Central Wáng Càn composed a five-character ode to praise the services, stating:
> Following the army has sufferings or joys
> Merely ask who is being followed
> If the followed is divine and martial
> How can the brigades be toiled for long?
> The Chancellor and Duke campaigned right of the Passes 
> Awe-inspiring fury shaking with Heavenly power
> In one move exterminated the Xūn caitiffs, 
> A second move subdued the Qiāng and Yí
> To the west captured the borderland bandits
> As suddenly as stooping for a dropped item
> Exhibiting rewards higher than mountain peaks
> Liquor and meat surpassing rivers and islands
> In the army many exuberant and full
> Men and horses overflowingly muscular
> Those that walked going out in carriages return
> Those with nothing setting out have abundance of wealth
> Expanding land three thousand lǐ
> Going and returning as fast as flying
> Singing and dancing entering Yè city
> What was desired obtained without omission
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　是行也，侍中王粲作五言詩以美其事曰：「從軍有苦樂，但問所從誰。所從神且武，安得久勞師？相公征關右，赫怒振天威，一舉滅獯虜，再舉服羌夷，西收邊地賊，忽若俯拾遺。陳賞越山嶽，酒肉踰川坻，軍中多饒飫，人馬皆溢肥，徒行兼乘還，空出有餘資。拓土三千里，往反速如飛，歌舞入鄴城，所願獲無違。」
:::
:::
:::

## Jiàn'ān 21 - 24 (216 - 219) {.unnumbered}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Twenty-First Year, Spring, Second Moon [216 Mar 7 – Apr 4], the Duke returned to Yè. <a href="#annotation-104" id="source-104">[104]</a> Third Moon [216 Apr 5 – May 4], Rényín [216 Apr 7], the Duke personally plowed the Register Field. <a href="#annotation-105" id="source-105">[105]</a> Summer, Fifth Moon [216 Jun 3 – Jul 2], Heaven’s Son advanced the Duke’s noble rank to King of Wèi. <a href="#annotation-106" id="source-106">[106]</a> Dài Prefecture’s Wūhuán Acting Chányú Pǔfùlú with his marquesses and kings came to Court. Heaven’s Son mandated that the King’s daughters be princesses, income from Tāngmùyì. <a href="#annotation-107" id="source-107">[107]</a> Autumn, Seventh Moon [216 Aug 1 – Aug 30], the Xiōngnú Southern Chányú Hūchúquán led his named kings to come to Court, cared for with rituals for a guest, and therefore remained in Wèi, having the Right Worthy King Qùbēi oversee their state. 
Eighth Moon [216 Aug 31 – Sep 28], Minister Judge Zhōng Yáo became Chancellor of State.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
二十一年春二月，公還鄴。〔一〕三月壬寅，公親耕籍田。〔二〕夏五月，天子進公爵為魏王。〔三〕代郡烏丸行單于普富盧與其侯王來朝。天子命王女為公主，食湯沐邑。秋七月，匈奴南單于呼廚泉將其名王來朝，待以客禮，遂留魏，使右賢王去卑監其國。八月，以大理鍾繇為相國。〔四〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-104" id="annotation-104">[104]</a> Wèi shū states: Xīnwèi [216 Mar 7], relevant managers with Grand Offering reported the arrival, tallied the achievements at the Temple. Jiǎwǔ [216 Mar 30], first Spring Sacrifices,  the Order said: “Commentators believe that at the Sacrificial Temple in ascending the Hall one should remove shoes. I accepted Bestowment mandate to wear sword and not remove shoes when ascending Halls. Now in services in the Temple removing shoes is to honor my ancestors but disregard the Ruler’s mandate, venerate father and grandfather but disparage lord and ruler, and therefore I do not dare remove shoes in ascending the Hall. Also, [they say] at the cleansing for the sacrifices, the hands touch the water but do not wash. Washing is to by cleanliness show veneration, and one has never heard of a ritual of touching but not washing. Moreover, ‘sacrifice to the spirits as if the spirits are present.’  Therefore I will personally accept the water and wash. Also, [they say] when the rituals of communing with the spirits finishes, descend the steps to the curtains and stand, waiting for the performance of the music to complete. This is to appear to not please the illustrious ancestors, laggard in sacrifices and rushing to finish. Therefore I will sit and wait for the music to complete, send off the spirit, and then rise. Accepting the sacrificial meat and storing it in sleeve, to give the Attendant Central, this is to not be thorough to the end in veneration and respect. The ancients personally handled the sacrificial matters; therefore I will personally store it in sleeve, carry it to the end, and return. Zhòngní said: ‘Though it opposes the majority, I continue below.’  How true those words!”
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏書曰：辛未，有司以太牢告至，策勳于廟，甲午始春祠，令曰：「議者以為祠廟上殿當解履。吾受錫命，帶劍不解履上殿。今有事於廟而解履，是尊先公而替王命，敬父祖而簡君主，故吾不敢解履上殿也。又臨祭就洗，以手擬水而不盥。夫盥以潔為敬，未聞擬（向）〔而〕不盥之禮，且『祭神如神在』，故吾親受水而盥也。又降神禮訖，下階就幕而立，須奏樂畢竟，似若不（愆）〔衎〕烈祖，遲祭（不）速訖也，故吾坐俟樂闋送神乃起也。受胙納（神）〔袖〕，以授侍中，此為敬恭不終實也，古者親執祭事，故吾親納于（神）〔袖〕，終抱而歸也。仲尼曰『雖違眾，吾從下』，誠哉斯言也。」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-105" id="annotation-105">[105]</a> Wèi shū states: Relevant managers memorialized: “In the four seasons there is instructing warfare during the breaks in agriculture. Hàn continued Qín’s systems, for three seasons not instructing, only in the Tenth Moon at the capital inspecting chariots and horses, visiting Cháng River South Gate, gathering the Five Regiments servicemen in the Eight Formations advancing and withdrawing, naming it as ‘Deploying Them.’  Now metal and leather have not yet been set down, servicemen and civilians are always training, from now on afterward we can do without four seasons of instructing warfare, only at the Start of Autumn select an auspicious day to greatly convene the chariots and cavalry, called as ‘Drilling Troops,’  above according with ritual names, below continuing Hàn’s systems.” Memorial approved.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　魏書曰：有司奏：「四時講武於農隙。漢承秦制，三時不講，唯十月都試車馬，幸長水南門，會五營士為八陳進退，名曰乘之。今金革未偃，士民素習，自今已後，可無四時講武，但以立秋擇吉日大朝車騎，號曰治兵，上合禮名，下承漢制。」奏可。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-106" id="annotation-106">[106]</a> Xiàn-dì zhuàn  records the Edict stating: “From antiquity, of the Emperors and Kings, although the titles changed from one another, the noble ranks not the same, as for commending and esteeming foundational merits, establishing achievements and virtues, glorifying clans and surnames, bequeathing to sons and grandsons, for the differently surnamed compared with for kin, how are there differences? In the past my sagely ancestor received the Mandate, started the enterprise and began the foundations, established our regions of Xià, reflected on ancient and modern systems, understood the differences in noble ranks, used all the mountains and rivers as enfeoffments to set vassal screens, and had the differently surnamed and close relatives both arrayed in lands, occupying states as kings, by this protected and governed Heaven’s Mandate, secured firmly for myriad successions, passing through generations in continued peace, servant and master without problems. In Shìzǔ’s Internal Restoration then at times there were difficulties and ease, and therefore after years of several hundreds, there were no differently surnamed vassal lords ranked as kings. As We are not virtuous but inherited a vast enterprise, encountered the lands divided and collapsed, crowds of the vicious unleashed cruelty, from the west reaching the east, suffering and impoverished. At this interval, I only feared drowning in the troubles and so shaming the sagely virtue of the former Emperors. Relying on the spirits of the August Heavens, they allowed you to maintain righteousness and exert yourself, shaking quickly your divine martial power, shielding Us from disaster and trouble, winning protection for the Ancestral Temples. Huáxià’s remnant peoples, all that draw breath, none are not immersed in it. Your diligence surpasses Jì and Yǔ, loyalty comparable to Yī [Yǐn] and Zhōu [gōng],  but conceal it with modest deference, maintain it with all the more reverence, and therefore formerly in the first founding of Wèi State, bestowing you with land, I feared you would oppose the command, worried of your firm refusals, and therefore temporarily held back will and subdued intentions, enfeoffing you as Highest Duke, wishing to venerate and follow high righteousness, to wait for distinguished achievements. Hán Suì and Sòng Jiàn to the south joined with Bā-Shǔ, crowds of rebels joining and following, plotting to endanger the State Altars, you again commanded the officers, dragon rising and tiger pouncing, beheaded their leaders, slaughtered their caves and perches. Reaching to the western campaign, at the battle of Yángpíng, you personally wore armor and helmet, deeply penetrated difficult terrain, cut down and razed the vermin rebels, exterminated their vicious and evil, cleansed and settled the western frontier, hanging banners ten thousand lǐ, sounds of instructions distantly shaking, pacifying our regions of Xià. Overall in the flourishing of Táng and Yú, the three lords planted achievements, in the rise of Wén and Wǔ, Dàn and Shì were the supporters, in the Two Zǔ achieving the enterprise, the outstanding and heroic assisted the mandate.  The sagely and wise lord takes on matters as his own responsibility, but yet bestows land and applies commendations to repay accomplished ministers. How can it be that We of scant virtues relied on you for relief and yet the reward standards are not abundant, how can it answer the divinities and deities and comfort the myriad quarters? Now advance your noble rank to King of Wèi, send Envoy Holding Stave Acting as Censorate Grandee the Minister of the Clan Liú Ài to present the conferment and Ruler’s Seal, dark earth for altar, bundled in white reeds, Metal Tiger Tallies rank one to rank five, Bamboo Envoy Tallies rank one to ten.  You are thus a true King’s rank, as Assistant Chancellor and designate Jì Province Governor as before. Thus send up your Duke of Wèi’s Seal and Ribbon and tallies and documents. Respectfully obey Our command, select and give relief to your multitudes, achieve and pacify many accomplishments, to raise up our ancestor’s glorious Mandate.” The King of Wèi sent up letters thrice declining, Edict thrice replied denying permission. Also hand wrote Edict that said: “Great sages take achievements and virtue as high beauty, take loyalty and harmony as canon teachings, therefore in initiating the enterprise and bequeathing reputation they allowed a hundred generations able to imitate, in acting by principle and governing by righteousness they allowed diligent action able to be emulated, and so their achievements and exploits were without limits, their glorious radiance dense and outstanding. Jì and Xiè conveyed the acute brilliance of the leading head, Zhōu and Shào continued the wise employments of Wén and Wǔ.  Although they managed the various offices, looking up to sigh and looking down to think, how can they compare to you? We ponder the achievements of the ancients, beautiful to that extent, think of your loyal and diligent accomplishments, flourishing to this extent, and so every time when about to engrave tallies and split tokens, lay out ritual mandate conferment, awake or asleep sighing thus, myself forgetting my lack of virtue to maintain culture.  Now you again disobey Our command, firmly declining with sincerity, this is not how to serve Our heart and instruct later generations. Thus restrain your will and reduce your integrity, do not again firmly decline.”

Sìtǐ Shūshì xù states: Liáng Hú appointed the Excellency as North Division Commandant.

Cáo Mán zhuàn states: He was by Secretariat Writers Right Deputy Sīmǎ Jiàn’gōng nominated. When the Excellency became King, he summoned Jiàn’gōng to Yè, with him happily drank, and said to Jiàn’gōng: “Today could I still be a Commandant or not?” Jiàn’gōng said: “In the past at the time I nominated you Great King, you were only suitable to be a Commandant.” The King greatly laughed.

Jiàn’gōng was named Fáng, Sīmǎ Xuān-wáng’s father. 

Your Servant Sōngzhī notes: According to Sīmǎ Biāo’s Xùzhuàn,  [Sīmǎ Fáng] Jiàn’gōng was not Right Deputy, so one suspects this is not correct, but Wáng Yǐn’s Jìn shū  says that when the King of Zhào [Sīmǎ Lún] usurped the throne,  he wished to honor his grandfather [Sīmǎ Fáng] as Emperor, and Academic Scholar Mǎ Píng  commented claiming that “the Jīngzhào Office Lord  in the past nominated Wèi Wǔ-dì as North Division Commandant, bandits did not violate the borders,” so by this then there is some evidence.

:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔三〕　獻帝傳載詔曰：「自古帝王，雖號稱相變，爵等不同，至乎褒崇元勳，建立功德，光啟氏姓，延於子孫，庶姓之與親，豈有殊焉。昔我聖祖受命，創業肇基，造我區夏，鑒古今之制，通爵等之差，盡封山川以立藩屏，使異姓親戚，並列土地，據國而王，所以保乂天命，安固萬嗣。歷世承平，臣主無事。世祖中興而時有難易，是以曠年數百，無異姓諸侯王之位。朕以不德，繼序弘業，遭率土分崩，群兇縱毒，自西徂東，辛苦卑約。當此之際，唯恐溺入于難，以羞先帝之聖德。賴皇天之靈，俾君秉義奮身，震迅神武，捍朕于艱難，獲保宗廟，華夏遺民，含氣之倫，莫不蒙焉。君勤過稷、禹，忠侔伊、周，而掩之以謙讓，守之以彌恭，是以往者初開魏國，錫君土宇，懼君之違命，慮君之固辭，故且懷志屈意，封君為上公，欲以欽順高義，須俟勳績。韓遂、宋建，南結巴、蜀，群逆合從，圖危社稷，君復命將，龍驤虎奮，梟其元首，屠其窟栖。暨至西征，陽平之役，親擐甲冑，深入險阻，芟夷蝥賊，殄其兇醜，盪定西陲，懸旌萬里，聲教遠振，寧我區夏。蓋唐、虞之盛，三后樹功，文、武之興，旦、奭作輔，二祖成業，英豪佐命；夫以聖哲之君，事為己任，猶錫土班瑞以報功臣，豈有如朕寡德，仗君以濟，而賞典不豐，將何以答神祇慰萬方哉？今進君爵為魏王，使使持節行御史大夫、宗正劉艾奉策璽玄土之社，苴以白茅，金虎符第一至第五，竹使符第一至十。君其正王位，以丞相領冀州牧如故。其上魏公璽綬符冊。敬服朕命，簡恤爾眾，克綏庶績，以揚我祖宗之休命。」魏王上書三辭，詔三報不許。又手詔曰：「大聖以功德為高美，以忠和為典訓，故創業垂名，使百世可希，行道制義，使力行可效，是以勳烈無窮，休光茂著。稷、契載元首之聰明，周、邵因文、武之智用，雖經營庶官，仰歎俯思，其對豈有若君者哉？朕惟古人之功，美之如彼，思君忠勤之績，茂之如此，是以每將鏤符析瑞，陳禮命冊，寤寐慨然，自忘守文之不德焉。今君重違朕命，固辭懇切，非所以稱朕心而訓後世也。其抑志撙節，勿復固辭。」四體書勢序曰：梁鵠以公為北部尉。曹瞞傳曰：為尚書右丞司馬建公所舉。及公為王，召建公到鄴，與歡飲，謂建公曰：「孤今日可復作尉否？」建公曰：「昔舉大王時，適可作尉耳。」王大笑。建公名防，司馬宣王之父。臣松之案司馬彪序傳，建公不為右丞，疑此不然，而王隱晉書云趙王篡位，欲尊祖為帝，博士馬平議稱京兆府君昔舉魏武帝為北部尉，賊不犯界，如此則為有徵。
:::
:::
:::

<a href="#source-107" id="annotation-107">[107]</a> Wèi shū states: First installed Minister of Presentations and Minister of the Clan offices.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔四〕　魏書曰：始置奉常宗正官。
:::
